title: 建筑：墙面、屋面、条带、立面、地标、城建标志构件与建造阶段

subject.zh: 洛萨乡镇的灰泥半木墙：奶油色灰泥 #e6dcc4 被深褐木筋 #5a3e28 分成竖向与斜向的格框，木筋宽约 20 厘米，格框约每 2 米重复一次，灰泥有细微抹痕与几处剥落，四方无缝
subject.en: Half-timbered plaster wall of a Lotha village: cream plaster #e6dcc4 divided by dark brown beams #5a3e28 into upright and diagonal panels, beams about 20 cm wide, the panel pattern repeating about every 2 m, faint trowel marks and a few flaked spots, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 本包的招牌墙材，M0 样板：木筋的格框节奏要规整，否则贴到长墙上会乱。四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 原木墙：横向叠放的去皮原木 #8a6440，每根直径约 25 厘米，原木之间填着灰褐苔泥 #5a3e24，木纹与节疤清楚，不画木端，原木行水平，四方无缝
subject.en: Log wall: peeled logs #8a6440 stacked horizontally, each about 25 cm thick, gray-brown moss and mud chinking #5a3e24 between them, clear grain and knots, no log ends shown, rows horizontal, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 刷白灰的石墙：粗砌的石块外抹一层白灰 #ece6d8，白灰有些地方脱落露出灰褐石块 #b8b0a0，墙面带着雨水留下的竖向淡痕，四方无缝
subject.en: Whitewashed stone wall: roughly laid stones under a coat of whitewash #ece6d8, the lime flaked in places to show gray-brown stone #b8b0a0, faint vertical rain streaks, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 竖向木板墙：宽窄不一的竖钉木板 #9a7448，板缝用细木条压住，木纹竖直，几块木板颜色略深或有修补，板行竖直，四方无缝
subject.en: Vertical plank wall: upright boards #9a7448 of varied widths, the joints covered with thin battens, vertical grain, a few boards darker or patched, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 灰石砌墙：大小不一的灰色毛石 #9a958a 错缝垒砌，灰浆暗灰 #6a665e，石面有凿痕与零星苔斑，用于礼拜堂、官署与镇北石墙，四方无缝
subject.en: Gray fieldstone wall: gray rubble stones #9a958a of varied size laid in a staggered bond, dark gray mortar #6a665e, chisel marks and a few moss spots, used for the chapel, civic buildings and the north town wall, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 镇子的木栅墙面：一根根竖立的原木 #7e5a36 紧挨着排列，每根约 25 厘米粗，中段横绑两道木条，树皮斑驳，四方无缝，顶部尖头由条带表现
subject.en: Village palisade face: upright logs #7e5a36 set tight side by side, each about 25 cm thick, two crosswise rails lashed across the middle, patchy bark, seamless on all sides; the pointed tops are handled by the trim

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 陶红筒瓦屋面：半圆筒瓦 #a8543a 一仰一俯排成竖列，瓦行水平，每行下沿一道暗线、上沿一道亮线，个别瓦片颜色偏赭黄 #b4823a，四方无缝
subject.en: Terracotta barrel tile roof: half-round tiles #a8543a laid alternately up and down in columns, rows horizontal with a dark line under and a light line along each row, a few tiles leaning ochre #b4823a, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 本包最常用的屋面，M0 样板。瓦行或草层必须水平、屋脊方向在上；不画屋脊与檐口（由条带贴）；生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝。

subject.zh: 茅草屋面：麦秆扎成的厚茅草层层压叠，草色金褐 #b4823a 夹着灰褐旧草，每层下沿剪得整齐，层次水平，草束方向朝下，四方无缝
subject.en: Thatched roof: thick wheat-straw thatch in overlapping courses, golden brown #b4823a mixed with gray-brown old straw, each course trimmed neatly along its lower edge, courses horizontal, straw pointing down, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 瓦行或草层必须水平、屋脊方向在上；不画屋脊与檐口（由条带贴）；生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝。

subject.zh: 木瓦屋面：长方形木片瓦 #9a7448 错缝叠铺，每块约 40 厘米长，木瓦风化发灰，个别翘起或颜色较新，瓦行水平，四方无缝
subject.en: Wooden shingle roof: rectangular wood shingles #9a7448 in a staggered lap, each about 40 cm long, weathered toward gray, a few curled or newer, rows horizontal, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 瓦行或草层必须水平、屋脊方向在上；不画屋脊与檐口（由条带贴）；生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝。

subject.zh: 蓝灰石板瓦屋面：薄而平的长方形石板瓦 #4e5a6e 错缝叠铺，瓦边略有缺口，深浅两色，瓦行水平，用于公会、礼拜堂与官署，四方无缝
subject.en: Blue-gray slate roof: thin flat rectangular slates #4e5a6e in a staggered lap, slightly chipped edges, two tones, rows horizontal, used for the guild, chapel and civic buildings, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 瓦行或草层必须水平、屋脊方向在上；不画屋脊与檐口（由条带贴）；生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝。

subject.zh: 洛萨乡镇民居的墙基、压檐与檐边：灰毛石与深褐木 #5a3e28 为主，木料带木纹与钉眼，石料有凿痕与苔斑，与灰泥半木墙、陶红瓦屋面配套
subject.en: Base, cap and eave trims for Lotha village houses: mainly gray fieldstone and dark brown timber #5a3e28, wood showing grain and nail holes, stone with chisel marks and moss, matching the half-timbered walls and terracotta roofs

extra.zh: 第 1 行墙基：灰毛石砌的勒脚；第 2 行墙顶压檐：深褐木梁压顶；第 3 行屋檐封边：深褐木封檐板带一排木钉；第 4 行山墙封檐板：带简单锯齿纹的木封檐板。
extra.en: Row 1 wall base: a gray fieldstone plinth; row 2 wall cap: a dark brown timber capping beam; row 3 eave fascia: a dark brown fascia board with a row of wooden pegs; row 4 gable bargeboard: a timber bargeboard with a simple sawtooth edge.

items.notes: 4 条之间用洋红隔开；每条的左右两端要能首尾相接；每条上沿留一道亮边。

subject.zh: 洛萨乡镇民居的立面构件：深褐木门 #6e4626 与木门框、带十字窗棂的木窗与木百叶，铁件锈黑，配色取灰泥白、木褐、陶红与暖黄窗光 #ffd58a，朴素结实
subject.en: Facade pieces for Lotha village houses: dark brown wooden doors #6e4626 and frames, wooden windows with cross mullions and shutters, rust-black ironwork, in plaster white, wood brown, terracotta and warm window light #ffd58a, plain and sturdy

extra.zh: 16 格依次为：门（关）、门（开，门内暗暖色）、窗（昼，木百叶半开）、窗（夜，窗内暖光）、小窗、圆窗、招牌甲（铁弯架挂空白木牌）、招牌乙（铁弯架挂酒杯纹章）、雨棚（陶红条纹布）、烟囱（石砌）、阳台（木栏）、花箱（红花）、壁灯（熄）、壁灯（亮）、门楣饰（木雕卷纹）、山墙饰（交叉木条）。
extra.en: The 16 cells in order: door closed, door open (dim warm interior), window by day (shutters half open), window by night (warm light inside), small window, round window, sign A (iron bracket with a blank wooden board), sign B (iron bracket with a mug emblem), awning (terracotta striped cloth), chimney (stone), balcony (wooden rail), flower box (red flowers), wall lamp off, wall lamp lit, lintel ornament (carved scroll), gable ornament (crossed timbers).

items.notes: M0 样板：这张定稿后是全部风格包立面构件的格式参照。16 格严格按补充说明的顺序；夜窗与点亮的灯用暖色自发光；招牌只画纹章图形，任何地方都不写字。

subject.zh: 洛萨乡镇店铺的纹章招牌与门脸：木牌与铁弯架上只画图形纹章，纹章是深色剪影配暖色底板，挂在铁弯架或门楣上，不含任何文字
subject.en: Emblem signs and shopfront pieces for Lotha village shops: wooden boards on iron brackets carrying only pictorial emblems, dark silhouettes on warm backing boards, hung from brackets or lintels, no lettering at all

extra.zh: 16 格依次为：酒杯（酒馆）、锤与砧（铁匠铺）、天平（店铺）、药草（医馆）、面包（面包房）、车轮（磨坊与车行）、马蹄铁（驿站）、盾（公会与营房）、书（学堂）、光轮圣徽（礼拜堂）、交叉剑与羽笔（冒险者公会）、钥匙（锁匠）、剪刀（裁缝）、鱼（鱼贩）、店铺双开木门、货摊遮阳布。
extra.en: The 16 cells in order: mug (tavern), hammer and anvil (smithy), scales (shop), herb (clinic), loaf (bakery), wheel (mill and carter), horseshoe (post station), shield (guild and barracks), book (school), halo sigil (chapel), crossed sword and quill (adventurers guild), key (locksmith), scissors (tailor), fish (fishmonger), double wooden shop door, stall sun cloth.

items.notes: 纹章要在 32 像素宽下认得出：一个剪影、两种颜色。16 格严格按补充说明的顺序；夜窗与点亮的灯用暖色自发光；招牌只画纹章图形，任何地方都不写字。

subject.zh: 礼拜堂与官署的立面构件：灰石门框、高大的拱形木门、圆形玫瑰窗与细长尖窗、青铜钟，配色取灰石、深褐木、蓝灰与暖黄窗光，庄重朴素
subject.en: Facade pieces for the chapel and civic buildings: gray stone frames, tall arched wooden doors, a round rose window and narrow lancets, a bronze bell, in gray stone, dark brown wood, blue-gray and warm window light, solemn and plain

extra.zh: 16 格依次为：拱门（关）、拱门（开）、尖窗（昼）、尖窗（夜，暖光）、玫瑰窗（昼）、玫瑰窗（夜，暖光）、告示板（钉着空白纸张）、光轮圣徽浮雕、石阶三级、青铜钟、石扶壁、铁栅小窗、壁灯（熄）、壁灯（亮）、石门楣饰（卷叶）、钟楼百叶窗。
extra.en: The 16 cells in order: arched door closed, arched door open, lancet window by day, lancet window by night (warm light), rose window by day, rose window by night (warm light), notice board with blank sheets, halo sigil relief, three stone steps, bronze bell, stone buttress, small barred window, wall lamp off, wall lamp lit, stone lintel ornament (leaf scroll), bell tower louver.

items.notes: 告示板上的纸张是空白的。16 格严格按补充说明的顺序；夜窗与点亮的灯用暖色自发光；招牌只画纹章图形，任何地方都不写字。

subject.zh: 边石镇礼拜堂的钟楼：灰石砌的方形钟楼，上部四面开拱形钟窗，窗里挂一口青铜钟，顶上是陡峭的蓝灰石板瓦尖顶，尖顶上立着一枚光轮圣徽，是全镇最高处
subject.en: The bell tower of the Edgestone chapel: a square gray stone tower with arched belfry openings on all four sides, a bronze bell hanging inside, a steep blue-gray slate spire on top crowned by a halo sigil, the tallest point in town

extra.zh: 约 4 米宽、9 米高（含尖顶）；只画钟楼本身，礼拜堂主体由墙面与屋面拼出；钟窗正对镜头。
extra.en: About 4 m wide and 9 m tall including the spire; draw only the tower, the chapel body is assembled from wall and roof textures; a belfry opening faces the viewer.

items.notes: 底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 磨坊的水车与水槽：直径约 4 米的木水车，十二片木叶板，铁箍轮轴，旁边一段架高的木水槽把水引到轮顶，木料被水泡得发黑
subject.en: The mill wheel and flume: a wooden waterwheel about 4 m across with twelve paddles and an iron-banded axle, an elevated wooden flume beside it carrying water to the top of the wheel, the timber darkened by water

extra.zh: 约 5 米宽、5 米高；水车侧面正对镜头，是正圆；轮的下缘截在画面底边。
extra.en: About 5 m wide and 5 m tall; the wheel is seen side-on as a true circle; its lower rim is cut by the image bottom.

items.notes: 不画水流、水花与水面，水由渲染层画。底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 边石镇北门的石砌门楼：灰毛石砌的方形门楼，中间一道拱形门洞，门洞上方是带垛口的哨台，门洞里是厚木包铁的双扇门，门楼两侧接着木栅，门上挂一盏铁灯
subject.en: The fieldstone gatehouse of Edgestone north gate: a square gray rubble gatehouse with an arched passage through its middle, a crenellated watch platform above, heavy iron-bound double doors in the passage, palisade stubs on both sides and an iron lamp over the gate

extra.zh: 约 6 米宽、7 米高；门洞居中正对镜头，两侧只露一小段木栅接头。
extra.en: About 6 m wide and 7 m tall; the passage is centered facing the viewer, with only short palisade stubs at the sides.

items.notes: 底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 旧哨村倒塌的石哨塔：灰石圆塔塌掉了上半截，断口参差，塔身有一道大裂缝，焦黑的楼板梁斜插在断口里，塔脚堆着落石与野草，塔门只剩空洞
subject.en: The collapsed stone watchtower of Oldwatch: a round gray stone tower missing its upper half, a jagged break, a great crack down the shaft, charred floor beams jutting from the break, fallen stones and weeds at its foot, the doorway an empty hole

extra.zh: 约 4 米宽、7 米高；只画倒塌态，修复后用城建的哨塔立牌。
extra.en: About 4 m wide and 7 m tall; draw only the ruined state, the repaired tower uses the city watchtower standee.

items.notes: 底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 猎户小屋的苔原木墙：粗细不一的原木 #846a4c 横向叠放，木皮未剥净，缝隙塞着绿苔 #4a7a3a 与泥，原木上长着苔斑，原木行水平，四方无缝
subject.en: Mossy log wall of a hunting cabin: logs #846a4c of uneven girth stacked horizontally with bark still on in places, gaps stuffed with green moss #4a7a3a and mud, moss spots on the logs, rows horizontal, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 风化的木板墙：竖钉的旧木板 #9a866c 晒成灰褐，木纹凸起，板缝间长着细苔，钉头锈黑，几块板子开裂，板行竖直，四方无缝
subject.en: Weathered plank wall: old upright boards #9a866c bleached gray-brown, raised grain, fine moss in the joints, rust-black nail heads, a few split boards, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 枝条编墙抹泥：竖桩之间编着细枝条 #846a4c，外面抹了一层褐泥 #5a3e2a，泥皮剥落处露出编条，墙面粗糙带手抹痕，四方无缝
subject.en: Wattle and daub wall: thin branches #846a4c woven between upright stakes, plastered over with brown mud #5a3e2a, the weave showing where the daub has fallen away, a rough hand-smoothed surface, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 林中长苔的残垣：古老的灰石 #6e7270 干砌，石块风化圆钝，大片苔藓 #4a7a3a 与藤蔓覆盖，石缝里长着小蕨，四方无缝
subject.en: Mossy ruin wall in the forest: old gray stones #6e7270 laid dry, weathered round, large patches of moss #4a7a3a and creeping vines, tiny ferns in the joints, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 匪帮营地的木栅：粗糙的原木 #5a3e2a 竖排，原木粗细不均、带着树皮，用麻绳与藤条横绑两道，原木之间留着缝隙，四方无缝
subject.en: Bandit camp palisade: rough upright logs #5a3e2a of uneven girth with bark on, lashed with hemp rope and vines in two bands, gaps between the logs, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 白桦村的桦木墙：横叠的白桦原木，树皮灰白带黑色横纹，原木间塞着苔，木头上偶有剥开的卷皮，原木行水平，四方无缝
subject.en: Birch log wall of a birch village: white birch logs stacked horizontally, pale gray-white bark with black horizontal marks, moss between the logs, a few curls of peeling bark, rows horizontal, seamless on all sides

items.notes: C5 夜风走廊的白桦村用。四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 长苔的木瓦屋面：厚木片瓦 #846a4c 错缝叠铺，瓦面大片覆盖绿苔与小蕨，木瓦边缘发黑腐朽，瓦行水平，四方无缝
subject.en: Mossy shingle roof: thick wood shingles #846a4c in a staggered lap, large areas covered with green moss and tiny ferns, the shingle edges dark and rotting, rows horizontal, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 瓦行或草层必须水平、屋脊方向在上；不画屋脊与檐口（由条带贴）；生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝。

subject.zh: 树皮板屋面：一块块剥下的粗树皮 #5a3e2a 压叠成屋面，树皮纹理粗犷，上面压着几根细木杆，树皮行水平，四方无缝
subject.en: Bark slab roof: rough slabs of stripped bark #5a3e2a overlapped as roofing, coarse bark texture, a few thin poles laid across to weigh it down, courses horizontal, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 瓦行或草层必须水平、屋脊方向在上；不画屋脊与檐口（由条带贴）；生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝。

subject.zh: 草皮屋面：切成方块的草皮一层层铺在屋顶上，草叶 #4a7a3a 与枯黄草交杂，草皮块之间露出黑土边，块行水平，四方无缝
subject.en: Turf roof: squares of cut turf laid in courses on the roof, green blades #4a7a3a mixed with dry yellow grass, dark soil showing between the squares, courses horizontal, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 瓦行或草层必须水平、屋脊方向在上；不画屋脊与檐口（由条带贴）；生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝。

subject.zh: 芦苇屋面：成束的灰黄芦苇 #b8c890 层层压叠，比麦秆茅草更细更直，每层下沿剪得齐，层次水平，四方无缝
subject.en: Reed thatch roof: bundles of gray-yellow reeds #b8c890 in overlapping courses, finer and straighter than wheat straw, each course trimmed level, courses horizontal, seamless on all sides

items.notes: C1-3 苇塘村的高脚屋用。瓦行或草层必须水平、屋脊方向在上；不画屋脊与檐口（由条带贴）；生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝。

subject.zh: 林中木屋的墙基、压檐与檐边：长苔的石块、去皮的原木与粗树皮，配色取苔绿、树皮褐与灰石，粗犷而不规整
subject.en: Base, cap and eave trims for forest cabins: mossy stones, peeled logs and rough bark in moss green, bark brown and gray stone, rugged and irregular

extra.zh: 第 1 行墙基：长苔的毛石垫脚；第 2 行墙顶压檐：一根带树皮的整原木；第 3 行屋檐封边：粗树皮钉成的封檐；第 4 行山墙封檐板：交叉的细原木杆。
extra.en: Row 1 wall base: mossy rubble footing stones; row 2 wall cap: one whole log with its bark; row 3 eave fascia: rough bark nailed as a fascia; row 4 gable bargeboard: crossed thin log poles.

items.notes: 4 条之间用洋红隔开；每条的左右两端要能首尾相接；每条上沿留一道亮边。

subject.zh: 猎户小屋的立面构件：粗木板门与兽皮门帘、带木百叶的小方窗、鹿角与兽皮挂饰，配色取树皮褐、苔绿与暖黄窗光，粗朴
subject.en: Facade pieces for hunting cabins: rough plank doors and hide door flaps, small square windows with wooden shutters, antler and hide trophies, in bark brown, moss green and warm window light, rustic

extra.zh: 16 格依次为：木板门（关）、兽皮门帘（掀开）、小方窗（昼，木百叶）、小方窗（夜，暖光）、透气小窗、圆形树节窗、鹿角挂饰、挂在墙上的兽皮、枝条雨棚、石砌烟囱、晾肉架、一束挂着的干草药、油灯（熄）、油灯（亮）、门楣上的兽头骨、山墙上交叉的木杆。
extra.en: The 16 cells in order: plank door closed, hide door flap pulled aside, small square window by day (shutters), small square window by night (warm light), small vent window, round knot-hole window, antler trophy, hide hung on the wall, woven branch awning, stone chimney, meat drying rack, a hanging bundle of dried herbs, oil lamp off, oil lamp lit, beast skull over the door, crossed poles on the gable.

items.notes: 16 格严格按补充说明的顺序；夜窗与点亮的灯用暖色自发光；招牌只画纹章图形，任何地方都不写字。

subject.zh: 林中匪帮哨所的立面构件：粗糙的木栅门、射孔、绳梯与破布旗，旗上只有几何纹，配色取暗褐木、麻绳黄与暗红破布，简陋而带敌意
subject.en: Facade pieces for a bandit outpost in the woods: crude palisade gates, arrow loops, rope ladders and ragged banners with geometric marks only, in dark brown wood, hemp yellow and dark red rags, makeshift and hostile

extra.zh: 16 格依次为：木栅门（关）、木栅门（开）、射孔（昼）、射孔（夜，火光）、窥孔、绳梯、破布旗（独眼几何纹）、挂着的骨串、木板雨棚、铁皮烟筒、瞭望小平台、一捆箭、火把（熄）、火把（燃）、门上钉着的兽骨、交叉的削尖木桩。
extra.en: The 16 cells in order: palisade gate closed, palisade gate open, arrow loop by day, arrow loop by night (firelight), peephole, rope ladder, ragged banner (one-eye geometric mark), string of bones, plank awning, tin stovepipe, small lookout platform, a bundle of arrows, torch out, torch burning, animal bones nailed over the gate, crossed sharpened stakes.

items.notes: 16 格严格按补充说明的顺序；夜窗与点亮的灯用暖色自发光；招牌只画纹章图形，任何地方都不写字。

subject.zh: 林地村落的立面构件：木门、带木格的窗、蜂箱与晾网，配色取木褐、芦苇黄与苔绿，温暖朴素，用于苇塘村、榆集与白桦村
subject.en: Facade pieces for woodland villages: wooden doors, lattice windows, beehives and drying nets, in wood brown, reed yellow and moss green, warm and plain, used for Reedpond, Elmfair and the birch villages

extra.zh: 16 格依次为：木门（关）、木门（开）、格子窗（昼）、格子窗（夜，暖光）、小窗、圆窗、招牌甲（鱼纹章）、招牌乙（蜂巢纹章）、芦苇雨棚、泥砌烟囱、木廊栏杆、花箱、壁灯（熄）、壁灯（亮）、山墙上挂的干芦苇束、山墙上的鹿角。
extra.en: The 16 cells in order: wooden door closed, wooden door open, lattice window by day, lattice window by night (warm light), small window, round window, sign A (fish emblem), sign B (honeycomb emblem), reed awning, mud chimney, porch railing, flower box, wall lamp off, wall lamp lit, a bundle of dry reeds hung on the gable, antlers on the gable.

items.notes: 16 格严格按补充说明的顺序；夜窗与点亮的灯用暖色自发光；招牌只画纹章图形，任何地方都不写字。

subject.zh: 林缘匪帮的木栅瞭望台：四根粗原木撑起约 6 米高的平台，平台围着削尖木栅，顶上搭着破布遮棚，一架绳梯从平台垂下，台脚堆着木箱与一只火盆
subject.en: A bandit palisade lookout at the forest edge: four thick logs holding a platform about 6 m up, the platform ringed with sharpened stakes and topped by a ragged cloth shelter, a rope ladder hanging down, crates and a brazier at the foot

extra.zh: 约 4 米宽、8 米高；略带俯视，看得见台面的一角。
extra.en: About 4 m wide and 8 m tall; slightly elevated view so a corner of the platform deck shows.

items.notes: 底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 猎人营地的斜顶窝棚：一面斜坡屋顶靠在大树根上，用细原木与树皮搭成，前面敞开挂着兽皮门帘，棚口摆着晾皮架与一把斧头，棚顶压着石块与苔
subject.en: A hunter lean-to at the camp: a single sloping roof propped against a big tree root, built from thin logs and bark, open at the front with a hide flap, a hide drying frame and an axe at the mouth, stones and moss weighing the roof

extra.zh: 约 4 米宽、3 米高；斜顶后高前低，敞口正对镜头。
extra.en: About 4 m wide and 3 m tall; the roof slopes from high at the back to low at the front, the open side facing the viewer.

items.notes: 底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 苇塘村的高脚屋：芦苇顶的木屋架在一排木桩上，离水面约 1.5 米，屋前有木廊与梯子通向栈道，墙上挂着渔网，木桩下半截被水泡黑
subject.en: A Reedpond stilt house: a reed-thatched wooden house raised on a row of piles about 1.5 m above the water, a front porch and a ladder down to the boardwalk, fishing nets hung on the wall, the lower piles darkened by water

extra.zh: 约 5 米宽、6 米高；只画完好态；木桩底部截齐，不画水面。
extra.en: About 5 m wide and 6 m tall; intact state only; piles cut straight at the bottom, no water surface.

items.notes: 底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 霜脊堡：山脊上的石堡，灰石厚墙带垛口，一座方形主塔与一道包铁木门，墙头插着北境军团的旗，墙脚立着防马的削尖木桩
subject.en: Frostridge fort: a stone fort on a ridge, thick gray walls with crenellations, a square keep and an iron-bound wooden gate, a northern legion banner on the wall, sharpened stakes against cavalry at the foot

extra.zh: 约 8 米宽、10 米高；主塔居中偏左，木门正对镜头；旗帜只画几何纹章。
extra.en: About 8 m wide and 10 m tall; the keep slightly left of center, the gate facing the viewer; the banner carries a geometric emblem only.

items.notes: 不画雪，冬季外观由天气层表现。底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 荒原灰石垒墙：大小不一的灰石块 #6e6054 干垒成墙，不用灰浆，石缝里塞着灰泥与碎木，石面蒙着一层灰白细灰 #b9b4a8，四方无缝
subject.en: Ash waste rubble wall: gray stones #6e6054 of every size piled dry with no mortar, gaps stuffed with ash mud and wood scraps, faces dusted with pale fine ash #b9b4a8, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 灰泥墙：用灰烬拌土抹成的墙面 #9a8a76，表面粗糙有手抹痕与干裂纹，几处剥落露出里面的碎石与草筋，颜色灰白偏暖，四方无缝
subject.en: Ash mud wall: a wall plastered with soil mixed with ash #9a8a76, rough with hand marks and drying cracks, a few spots fallen away to show rubble and straw binding, pale gray with a warm cast, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 焦木板墙：烧焦后仍被拿来用的木板 #3a2e28，表面焦黑起鳞，木纹处露出暗褐，板子长短不一用锈钉钉在一起，板行竖直，四方无缝
subject.en: Charred plank wall: burned boards #3a2e28 put back to use, the surface black and scaly, dark brown showing along the grain, boards of uneven length held with rusty nails, upright, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 荒原黑岩墙：方整的黑岩块 #45403e 错缝砌筑，岩面有细小气孔，石缝灰浆是铁锈红 #8a3a24，墙面落着一层灰，四方无缝
subject.en: Ash waste black rock wall: squared black stones #45403e in a staggered bond, fine pores on the faces, rust red mortar #8a3a24, a film of ash over everything, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 门站的门石墙：千门时代切割的浅灰门石 #9a8a76 大方块，砌缝细如发丝，每块石面刻着一道浅浅的门形边框，被灰与焦痕半掩，四方无缝
subject.en: Gate stone wall of a gate station: large pale gray gate stones #9a8a76 cut long ago, joints as fine as a hair, each face carved with a shallow door-shaped border, half hidden by ash and scorch marks, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 门形边框只是浅刻线，不发光、不用门扉金。四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 千门都外环古民居的旧砖墙：窄长的灰褐古砖 #6e6054 一顺一丁砌筑，砖面风化起砂，墙上布满门牌被凿掉后留下的钉孔与焦痕，四方无缝
subject.en: Old brick wall of the outer-ring wards: narrow gray-brown ancient bricks #6e6054 in a header and stretcher bond, faces weathered to grit, dotted with nail holes and scorch marks where house plates were chiseled away, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 焦木瓦屋面：被火燎过的木瓦 #3a2e28 错缝叠铺，瓦面焦黑起鳞，边缘烧缺，落满灰白细灰，瓦行水平，四方无缝
subject.en: Scorched shingle roof: fire-licked wooden shingles #3a2e28 in a staggered lap, black and scaly, edges burned away, covered in pale fine ash, rows horizontal, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 瓦行或草层必须水平、屋脊方向在上；不画屋脊与檐口（由条带贴）；生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝。

subject.zh: 覆灰土的平顶：木椽上铺草席再压一层灰土 #6e6054，表面拍实，有干裂纹与几簇枯草，纹理均匀，四方无缝
subject.en: Flat ash-earth roof: straw matting laid over rafters and covered with a layer of ashy soil #6e6054, tamped flat, drying cracks and a few tufts of dead grass, an even texture, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 瓦行或草层必须水平、屋脊方向在上；不画屋脊与檐口（由条带贴）；生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝。

subject.zh: 营帐的帆布顶：灰褐粗帆布 #9a8a76 拼缝而成，缝线粗，布面有补丁、焦洞与灰渍，布幅水平，四方无缝
subject.en: Tent canvas roof: coarse gray-brown canvas #9a8a76 sewn in panels with heavy seams, patches, burn holes and ash stains, panels horizontal, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 瓦行或草层必须水平、屋脊方向在上；不画屋脊与檐口（由条带贴）；生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝。

subject.zh: 千门都古民居的旧瓦：深灰的平板古瓦 #45403e 叠铺，瓦面有一道浅浅的凸棱，许多瓦片碎裂缺角，积着厚灰，瓦行水平，四方无缝
subject.en: Old roof tiles of the gate-city wards: dark gray flat ancient tiles #45403e lapped in rows, each with a shallow raised rib, many cracked or chipped, thick ash lying on them, rows horizontal, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 瓦行或草层必须水平、屋脊方向在上；不画屋脊与檐口（由条带贴）；生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝。

subject.zh: 荒原屋舍的墙基、压檐与檐边：灰石、焦木与锈铁，配色取灰白、焦黑与铁锈，粗陋而残破
subject.en: Base, cap and eave trims for ash waste dwellings: gray stone, charred wood and rusty iron in pale gray, charred black and rust, crude and broken

extra.zh: 第 1 行墙基：灰石干垒的勒脚，石缝塞着灰泥；第 2 行墙顶压檐：一排压着石块的焦木；第 3 行屋檐封边：钉着锈铁皮的木封檐；第 4 行山墙封檐板：破损的焦木封檐板，挂着一截锈链。
extra.en: Row 1 wall base: a dry-stacked gray stone plinth with ash mud in the gaps; row 2 wall cap: a row of charred timbers weighed with stones; row 3 eave fascia: a wooden fascia patched with rusty sheet iron; row 4 gable bargeboard: a broken charred bargeboard with a short rusty chain hanging from it.

items.notes: 4 条之间用洋红隔开；每条的左右两端要能首尾相接；每条上沿留一道亮边。

subject.zh: 荒原灰村残屋的立面构件：残破的门洞、塌了一半的窗、门形旧木牌与防风挡板，配色取灰白、焦黑与铁锈，荒凉但轮廓清楚
subject.en: Facade pieces for ruined ash hamlet houses: broken doorways, half-collapsed windows, old door-shaped plaques and wind shutters, in pale gray, charred black and rust, desolate but clearly outlined

extra.zh: 16 格依次为：破木门（关）、只剩门框的门洞、塌半的窗（昼）、有人住的窗（夜，暖光）、钉着木条的小窗、防风挡板、门形旧木牌（无字）、骨原拾来的铁环、破帆布雨棚、锈铁皮烟筒、塌落的二楼残台、干枯的花盆、油灯（熄）、油灯（亮）、焦黑的门楣、锈蚀的风向标。
extra.en: The 16 cells in order: broken wooden door closed, an empty doorframe, half-collapsed window by day, an inhabited window by night (warm light), small boarded window, wind shutter, old door-shaped plaque with no writing, an iron ring scavenged from the Bone Plain, torn canvas awning, rusty tin stovepipe, collapsed upper floor stub, withered flower pot, oil lamp off, oil lamp lit, charred lintel, rusted weathervane.

items.notes: 16 格严格按补充说明的顺序；夜窗与点亮的灯用暖色自发光；招牌只画纹章图形，任何地方都不写字。

subject.zh: 折桥驿匪帮据点的立面构件：包铁木门、射孔、木瞭望窗与马厩门，旗帜只有独眼几何纹，配色取焦木褐、锈铁与灰石，粗硬
subject.en: Facade pieces for the Brokenspan bandit post: iron-bound doors, arrow loops, wooden lookout windows and stable doors, banners with only a one-eye geometric mark, in charred brown, rusty iron and gray stone, hard and rough

extra.zh: 16 格依次为：包铁木门（关）、包铁木门（开）、射孔（昼）、射孔（夜，火光）、马厩双开门、木格窗、独眼纹旗、交叉骨棒旗、帆布雨棚、石砌烟囱、木挑台、一排水桶、火盆壁架（熄）、火盆壁架（燃）、门楣上的兽头骨、钉在墙上的空白木板。
extra.en: The 16 cells in order: iron-bound door closed, iron-bound door open, arrow loop by day, arrow loop by night (firelight), double stable door, wooden lattice window, one-eye banner, crossed bone-club banner, canvas awning, stone chimney, wooden outrigger platform, a row of water buckets, brazier bracket unlit, brazier bracket burning, beast skull over the lintel, a blank board nailed to the wall.

items.notes: 16 格严格按补充说明的顺序；夜窗与点亮的灯用暖色自发光；招牌只画纹章图形，任何地方都不写字。

subject.zh: 千门都万户街的门巷构件：不同年代与材质的门一扇挨一扇，门板褪色，门牌被凿掉，配色取灰褐、旧铜与淡金微光，安静而怪异
subject.en: Door alley pieces for the Myriad Doors Ward: doors of many ages and materials standing one after another, faded panels, house plates chiseled away, in gray-brown, old copper and a faint pale gold glow, quiet and uncanny

extra.zh: 16 格依次为：木拱门（关）、铁皮门（关）、雕花双扇门（关）、低矮的石门（关）、圆顶门（半开，门内暗）、条板门（半开）、铜钉门（关）、窄门（关）、门牌被凿掉的门楣、凿痕累累的门牌位、门环、门槛石、门灯（熄）、门灯（亮，淡金）、门框残骸、门前的旧门帘。
extra.en: The 16 cells in order: arched wooden door closed, sheet iron door closed, carved double door closed, low stone door closed, round-topped door ajar (dark inside), batten door ajar, studded copper door closed, narrow door closed, a lintel with its plate chiseled off, a battered plate recess, door knocker, threshold stone, door lamp off, door lamp lit (pale gold), broken doorframe, an old door curtain.

items.notes: 凿痕是凌乱的刀口，不能像字或数字。16 格严格按补充说明的顺序；夜窗与点亮的灯用暖色自发光；招牌只画纹章图形，任何地方都不写字。

subject.zh: 荒原灰村的残墙与门牌：一段约 3 米高的灰石残墙，墙上留着一个门洞，门洞上方钉着一块门形的旧木牌，墙后露出焦黑的屋梁，墙脚堆着灰与碎瓦
subject.en: A ruined ash hamlet wall with its door plaque: a stretch of gray stone wall about 3 m high with a doorway, an old door-shaped wooden plaque nailed above it, charred roof beams showing behind, ash and broken tiles heaped at its foot

extra.zh: 约 6 米宽、4 米高；木牌只有门的形状，没有字。
extra.en: About 6 m wide and 4 m tall; the plaque is only a door shape with no writing.

items.notes: 底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 折桥驿：削尖木栅围起的旧驿站，两层石砌主屋配焦木瓦顶，石砌马厩改成了仓库，木栅门上挂着独眼图形的旗，栅后立着一座木瞭望台
subject.en: Brokenspan Post: an old relay station ringed by a sharpened palisade, a two-story stone main house with a scorched shingle roof, a stone stable turned storehouse, a one-eye banner over the palisade gate, a wooden lookout tower behind

extra.zh: 约 8 米宽、9 米高；以木栅门为中心，主屋与瞭望台在其后。
extra.en: About 8 m wide and 9 m tall; centered on the palisade gate with the house and lookout behind it.

items.notes: 底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 门站大厅：门石砌成的圆厅只剩半圈墙，中央立着一副高约 5 米的大门框，门框基座有一个空凹位，四周的门柱残列断成高低不一的石桩，覆着灰
subject.en: Gate station hall: a round hall of gate stone with only half its wall left, a great doorframe about 5 m tall standing in the middle with an empty socket in its base, the surrounding colonnade broken into stumps of uneven height, all under ash

extra.zh: 约 8 米宽、9 米高；画最完整的西南站；门框是空的，不发光。
extra.en: About 8 m wide and 9 m tall; draw the most intact southwest station; the doorframe is empty and unlit.

items.notes: 其余三站的破损态与复原后的发光态不在本条，复原发光由特效叠加。底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 主门遗址：一副断成两截的巨大门框，左半截仍立着，右半截倒在一旁，断面上嵌着一截巨大的剑尖，门框石面刻着门形纹，被光蚀成一道道发白的痕
subject.en: The ruin of the main gate: a colossal doorframe broken in two, the left half still standing, the right half fallen beside it, the tip of an enormous sword lodged in the break, the stone carved with door patterns and seared by light into pale streaks

extra.zh: 只画画面放得下的一段，约 8 米宽、12 米高；整体的巨大比例由远景补。
extra.en: Draw only the part that fits, about 8 m wide and 12 m tall; the full colossal scale is carried by the backdrop.

items.notes: 底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 神庭的白色大理石墙：大块象牙白大理石 #eeeae2 对缝砌筑，砌缝极细，石面带淡淡的灰紫云纹 #a89cc8，干净无尘，四方无缝
subject.en: White marble wall of the divine court: large ivory marble blocks #eeeae2 joint to joint, extremely fine joints, faint gray-violet veining #a89cc8, spotless, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 金饰白墙板：白石墙面 #f4f0e6 被细金线 #c8a04a 分成等大的竖向长方格，每格上下角各有一枚小小的金色卷叶纹，格框整齐，四方无缝
subject.en: Gilded white wall panels: a white stone wall #f4f0e6 divided by fine gold lines #c8a04a into equal upright rectangles, a tiny gold leaf scroll at the top and bottom corners of each, perfectly regular, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 候见厅的白色帘幕墙：从高处垂下的厚白绸 #f4f0e6 帘幕，褶皱竖直均匀，褶间是浅灰紫的阴面，帘布的上下缘都不画，四方无缝
subject.en: White curtain wall of the antechamber: heavy white silk #f4f0e6 hanging from high above in even vertical folds, pale gray-violet in the hollows, neither the top nor the hem shown, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 帘幕门格的墙面；褶皱节奏要均匀，左右拼接看不出接缝。四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 庭院小屋的蜂蜜色木板墙：横向的宽木板 #d0b070，木纹细直，接缝错开，板缝里嵌着白石色的细灰缝，干净温暖，四方无缝
subject.en: Honey-colored board wall of the court cottage: wide horizontal boards #d0b070 with fine straight grain and staggered joints, thin white-stone colored pointing between them, clean and warm, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 修剪成墙的庭院绿篱：密实的小叶灌木 #7ab868 修成平整的墙面，叶片细密，偶见白色小花，表面平直，四方无缝
subject.en: A court hedge trimmed into a wall: dense small-leaved shrubs #7ab868 clipped to a flat face, fine leaves, an occasional small white flower, perfectly flat, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 审庭的高墙：纯白石墙 #f4f0e6 上每隔约 2 米立一根浅浮雕的细方柱，柱头是简洁的金色横线，墙面别无他物，冷而庄重，四方无缝
subject.en: The high wall of the court of review: a pure white stone wall #f4f0e6 with a slender shallow pilaster every 2 m or so, each capped by a plain gold band, nothing else on the wall, cold and solemn, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 第六幕审庭外观组。四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 金箔瓦屋面：小块方形瓦面贴着金箔 #c8a04a，金色深浅三级交错，瓦行水平，每行下沿一道暖褐暗线，不画反光高光，四方无缝
subject.en: Gold-leaf tile roof: small square tiles faced with gold leaf #c8a04a in three interleaved shades, rows horizontal with a warm brown line under each row, no drawn glare, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 金用三级而不是一片亮黄。瓦行或草层必须水平、屋脊方向在上；不画屋脊与檐口（由条带贴）；生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝。

subject.zh: 白釉筒瓦屋面：乳白釉面的筒瓦 #f4f0e6 排成竖列，瓦行水平，瓦缝浅灰紫 #a89cc8，每片瓦头有一道细金边，四方无缝
subject.en: White glazed barrel tile roof: milky white glazed tiles #f4f0e6 in columns, rows horizontal, pale gray-violet gaps #a89cc8, a thin gold edge on each tile end, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 瓦行或草层必须水平、屋脊方向在上；不画屋脊与檐口（由条带贴）；生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝。

subject.zh: 庭院小屋的木瓦：蜂蜜色的新木瓦 #d0b070 整齐错缝叠铺，木纹清楚，没有苔与风化，瓦行水平，四方无缝
subject.en: Court cottage shingles: new honey-colored shingles #d0b070 in a neat staggered lap, clear grain, no moss or weathering, rows horizontal, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 瓦行或草层必须水平、屋脊方向在上；不画屋脊与檐口（由条带贴）；生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝。

subject.zh: 兽舍的干草顶：松软的金黄干草 #e8c86a 厚厚铺成，草束朝下，下沿修得整齐，草色干净明亮，层次水平，四方无缝
subject.en: Hay roof of the court kennel: soft golden hay #e8c86a laid thick, stalks pointing down, lower edges trimmed neat, clean and bright, courses horizontal, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 瓦行或草层必须水平、屋脊方向在上；不画屋脊与檐口（由条带贴）；生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝。

subject.zh: 神庭建筑的墙基、压檐与檐边：白色大理石线脚与细金线，线脚简洁规整，配色取白、浅灰紫与金
subject.en: Base, cap and eave trims for divine court buildings: white marble moldings with fine gold lines, simple and exact, in white, pale gray-violet and gold

extra.zh: 第 1 行墙基：带一道金线的白石勒脚；第 2 行墙顶压檐：白石压顶线脚；第 3 行屋檐封边：白石檐口带一排小金珠饰；第 4 行山墙封檐板：白石封檐带金色回纹。
extra.en: Row 1 wall base: a white stone plinth with one gold line; row 2 wall cap: a white stone coping molding; row 3 eave fascia: a white stone cornice with a row of small gold beads; row 4 gable bargeboard: a white stone verge with a gold meander.

items.notes: 4 条之间用洋红隔开；每条的左右两端要能首尾相接；每条上沿留一道亮边。

subject.zh: 门内庭院小屋的立面构件：蜂蜜色木门、带门廊的窗、长椅与灯，配色取暖木、白石与暖黄，温暖安心
subject.en: Facade pieces for the inner court cottage: honey-colored wooden doors, porch windows, a bench and lamps, in warm wood, white stone and warm yellow, comforting

extra.zh: 16 格依次为：木门（关）、木门（开）、方窗（昼）、方窗（夜，暖光）、小窗、圆窗、窗台上的空食盆、门廊长椅、木雨棚、白石烟囱、木栏小阳台、花箱（白花）、门灯（熄）、门灯（亮）、木门楣、山墙上的白木格。
extra.en: The 16 cells in order: wooden door closed, wooden door open, square window by day, square window by night (warm light), small window, round window, an empty food bowl on the sill, porch bench, wooden awning, white stone chimney, small wooden balcony, flower box (white flowers), door lamp off, door lamp lit, wooden lintel, white lattice on the gable.

items.notes: 16 格严格按补充说明的顺序；夜窗与点亮的灯用暖色自发光；招牌只画纹章图形，任何地方都不写字。

subject.zh: 候见厅的立面构件：白色帘幕门格、号码板、白石门框与金色烛台，配色取白、浅灰紫与金，整洁得让人不安
subject.en: Facade pieces for the antechamber: white curtained doorways, a number board, white stone frames and gold candle sconces, in white, pale gray-violet and gold, unsettlingly tidy

extra.zh: 16 格依次为：帘幕门格（合拢）、帘幕门格（拉开，后面是更亮的白）、高窗（昼，白光）、高窗（暗）、号码板（板面空白）、长椅靠背、白石门框、金色壁烛台（熄）、金色壁烛台（亮）、白石柱头、垂落的金穗、白石台阶、金色拉绳、白绸束带、门楣饰（简洁金线）、山墙饰（白石三角楣）。
extra.en: The 16 cells in order: curtained doorway closed, curtained doorway drawn open (brighter white behind), high window by day (white light), high window dim, number board with a blank face, bench back, white stone doorframe, gold wall sconce unlit, gold wall sconce lit, white stone capital, hanging gold tassel, white stone steps, gold pull cord, white silk tie-back, lintel ornament (a plain gold line), gable ornament (white stone pediment).

items.notes: 号码板只画空白的板面，号码由界面绘制。16 格严格按补充说明的顺序；夜窗与点亮的灯用暖色自发光；招牌只画纹章图形，任何地方都不写字。

subject.zh: 审庭的立面构件：高大的白石门、细长高窗、五枚神纹浮雕与一个空白纹位，配色取白、金与浅灰紫，庄重冰冷
subject.en: Facade pieces for the court of review: tall white stone doors, narrow high windows, five divine sigil reliefs and one blank sigil place, in white, gold and pale gray-violet, solemn and cold

extra.zh: 16 格依次为：白石大门（关）、白石大门（开）、高窗（昼）、高窗（暗）、光轮纹浮雕、断剑纹浮雕、硬币纹浮雕、枝叶纹浮雕、书卷纹浮雕、空白的纹饰位、金色壁烛台（熄）、金色壁烛台（亮）、白绸垂帘、金穗、门楣饰（金线）、山墙饰（白石三角楣）。
extra.en: The 16 cells in order: white stone door closed, white stone door open, high window by day, high window dim, halo sigil relief, broken sword sigil relief, coin sigil relief, branch sigil relief, scroll sigil relief, a blank sigil place, gold wall sconce unlit, gold wall sconce lit, white silk drape, gold tassel, lintel ornament (gold line), gable ornament (white stone pediment).

items.notes: 神纹是简洁的图形，五枚大小一致。16 格严格按补充说明的顺序；夜窗与点亮的灯用暖色自发光；招牌只画纹章图形，任何地方都不写字。

subject.zh: 候见厅的白石门廊：四根白色大理石柱撑起三角楣，柱头是简洁的金色环带，门廊深处垂着合拢的白色帘幕，前有三级台阶，两侧各立一只金色烛台
subject.en: The white stone portico of the antechamber: four white marble columns carrying a pediment, plain gold bands at the capitals, closed white curtains hanging deep in the porch, three steps in front, a gold candle stand on each side

extra.zh: 约 7 米宽、7 米高；正面对称。
extra.en: About 7 m wide and 7 m tall; strictly symmetrical front view.

items.notes: 底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 门内庭院的小屋：带门廊的小木屋，蜂蜜色木墙、白石墙脚与白石烟囱，木瓦屋顶，门前一张长椅与一盏灯，窗台上一只空食盆
subject.en: The cottage of the inner court: a small wooden house with a porch, honey-colored board walls, a white stone footing and chimney, a shingle roof, a bench and a lamp by the door, an empty food bowl on the windowsill

extra.zh: 约 5 米宽、5 米高（含屋顶）；门廊居中。
extra.en: About 5 m wide and 5 m tall including the roof; the porch centered.

items.notes: 底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 庭泉的白石小亭：六根细白石柱撑起金箔小圆顶，亭下是圆形白石泉池的池沿，柱间挂着薄白纱，亭顶尖端一枚小小的金色圆珠
subject.en: The white stone pavilion over the court spring: six slender white columns holding a small gold-leaf dome, the rim of a round white stone basin below, sheer white gauze between the columns, a small gold ball at the finial

extra.zh: 约 5 米宽、6 米高；不画泉水，池沿以上是立牌。
extra.en: About 5 m wide and 6 m tall; no water, the standee starts at the basin rim.

items.notes: 底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 审庭的半圆后殿：高大的白石半圆墙面，嵌着一排细长高窗，墙前是一道六级的白石高台，墙顶一圈金色檐线，空旷而庄严
subject.en: The apse of the court of review: a tall curved white stone wall set with a row of narrow high windows, a six-step white stone dais before it, a gold cornice line along the top, empty and austere

extra.zh: 约 8 米宽、10 米高；正面对称；不画人与座椅（席位是道具）。
extra.en: About 8 m wide and 10 m tall; symmetrical; no people or seats (the seats are props).

items.notes: 底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 瓦伦堡的砖墙：暗红砖 #a8583e 一顺一丁砌筑，砖缝灰白，砖面有烟熏的暗斑与几块颜色更深的修补砖，四方无缝
subject.en: Valenburg brick wall: dark red bricks #a8583e in a header and stretcher bond, pale gray joints, smoky dark patches and a few darker replacement bricks, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 城邑的方石墙：切割规整的灰石块 #7e7a72 错缝砌筑，石缝细直，石面有细凿纹与雨水留下的竖向暗痕，四方无缝
subject.en: City ashlar wall: regular cut gray blocks #7e7a72 in a staggered bond, fine straight joints, light tooling and dark vertical rain streaks, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 城中的半木墙：灰白灰泥 #d8d0c0 被深褐木梁分成密集的竖格，木梁比乡镇的更细更密，灰泥被烟熏得发灰，四方无缝
subject.en: City half-timbered wall: pale gray plaster #d8d0c0 divided by dark brown timbers into close upright panels, the timbers thinner and denser than in the villages, the plaster grayed by smoke, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 瓦伦堡厚重的城墙面：巨大的灰石块 #66686e 砌成，石块之间夹着几层扁平的找平石，石面粗糙，有箭痕与苔斑，显得非常厚实，四方无缝
subject.en: The heavy face of the Valenburg city wall: huge gray blocks #66686e with courses of thin leveling stones between them, rough faces with arrow scars and moss, very massive, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 河港仓库的焦油木板墙：横钉的厚木板 #6e3a2a 涂过焦油，泛着暗褐光，板缝用麻絮塞住，板面有水渍与白色盐痕，板行水平，四方无缝
subject.en: Tarred plank wall of a harbor warehouse: thick boards #6e3a2a nailed horizontally and coated with tar, a dark brown sheen, oakum in the seams, water marks and pale salt stains, rows horizontal, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 泥巷棚屋的拼补墙：旧砖、碎木板与草帘胡乱拼在一起，钉着锈铁皮补丁，颜色暗褐灰杂，缝里透着黑，四方无缝
subject.en: Patchwork wall of the Mud Lane shacks: old bricks, broken boards and straw matting jammed together, rusty sheet iron patches nailed over them, mixed dark browns and grays, black showing through the gaps, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 蓝灰石板瓦屋面：长方形石板瓦 #56657a 错缝叠铺，瓦片薄而平整，深浅两级，几片新换的瓦颜色更蓝，瓦行水平，四方无缝
subject.en: Blue-gray slate roof: rectangular slates #56657a in a staggered lap, thin and flat, two tones, a few newer slates bluer, rows horizontal, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 本包最常用的屋面。瓦行或草层必须水平、屋脊方向在上；不画屋脊与檐口（由条带贴）；生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝。

subject.zh: 城中酒馆的红陶瓦屋面：平板红陶瓦 #8a3e30 错缝叠铺，瓦面有烟熏的暗斑，瓦行水平，每行下沿一道暗线，四方无缝
subject.en: Red clay tile roof of city taverns: flat red clay tiles #8a3e30 in a staggered lap, smoky dark patches, rows horizontal with a dark line under each row, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 瓦行或草层必须水平、屋脊方向在上；不画屋脊与檐口（由条带贴）；生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝。

subject.zh: 大教堂的鱼鳞石板瓦：下沿切成圆弧的石板瓦 #3e4a5e 叠成鱼鳞纹，深浅两色交错成横向条带，瓦行水平，四方无缝
subject.en: Fish-scale slates of the cathedral: slates with rounded lower edges #3e4a5e lapped into a scale pattern, two tones alternating in horizontal bands, rows horizontal, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 瓦行或草层必须水平、屋脊方向在上；不画屋脊与檐口（由条带贴）；生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝。

subject.zh: 河港仓栈的焦油木瓦：涂过焦油的深褐木瓦错缝叠铺，瓦面泛着暗光，零星有白色盐斑，瓦行水平，四方无缝
subject.en: Tarred shingles of the harbor warehouses: dark brown tarred wooden shingles in a staggered lap, a dull sheen, a few pale salt spots, rows horizontal, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 瓦行或草层必须水平、屋脊方向在上；不画屋脊与檐口（由条带贴）；生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝。

subject.zh: 瓦伦堡建筑的墙基、压檐与檐边：方石勒脚、石砌压顶与深色木封檐，配色取冷灰石、砖红与蓝灰，规整坚固
subject.en: Base, cap and eave trims for Valenburg buildings: ashlar plinths, stone copings and dark timber fascias in cool gray stone, brick red and blue-gray, regular and solid

extra.zh: 第 1 行墙基：大方石勒脚带一道斜面；第 2 行墙顶压檐：方石压顶线；第 3 行屋檐封边：深色木封檐板，下挂铁皮檐沟；第 4 行山墙封檐板：带简单刻线的深色木封檐。
extra.en: Row 1 wall base: a large ashlar plinth with a sloped top; row 2 wall cap: an ashlar coping line; row 3 eave fascia: a dark timber fascia with a sheet iron gutter; row 4 gable bargeboard: a dark timber bargeboard with simple incised lines.

items.notes: 4 条之间用洋红隔开；每条的左右两端要能首尾相接；每条上沿留一道亮边。

subject.zh: 瓦伦堡联排屋的立面构件：深色木门、带石窗台的格子窗、铁招牌架与条纹雨棚，配色取冷灰、砖红、蓝灰与暖黄窗光，规整而有烟火气
subject.en: Facade pieces for Valenburg row houses: dark wooden doors, lattice windows with stone sills, iron sign brackets and striped awnings, in cool gray, brick red, blue-gray and warm window light, orderly and lived in

extra.zh: 16 格依次为：木门（关）、木门（开）、格子窗（昼）、格子窗（夜，暖光）、小窗、圆窗、铁招牌架挂天平纹章、铁招牌架挂酒杯纹章、条纹雨棚、砖砌烟囱、铁栏小阳台、花箱、壁灯（熄）、壁灯（亮）、石门楣饰、山墙饰（木雕）。
extra.en: The 16 cells in order: wooden door closed, wooden door open, lattice window by day, lattice window by night (warm light), small window, round window, iron bracket with a scales emblem, iron bracket with a mug emblem, striped awning, brick chimney, small iron balcony, flower box, wall lamp off, wall lamp lit, stone lintel ornament, carved gable ornament.

items.notes: 16 格严格按补充说明的顺序；夜窗与点亮的灯用暖色自发光；招牌只画纹章图形，任何地方都不写字。

subject.zh: 大教堂与官署的立面构件：高大的尖拱木门、彩色玻璃尖窗、玫瑰窗与石雕，彩色玻璃只拼几何色块，配色取冷灰石、蓝灰与金
subject.en: Facade pieces for the cathedral and civic halls: tall pointed-arch doors, stained-glass lancets, rose windows and carvings, the glass only geometric color blocks, in cool gray stone, blue-gray and gold

extra.zh: 16 格依次为：尖拱大门（关）、尖拱大门（开）、彩色玻璃尖窗（昼）、彩色玻璃尖窗（夜，透出暖光）、玫瑰窗（昼）、玫瑰窗（夜）、白钟纹章浮雕、光轮圣徽浮雕、石扶壁、简化的兽首滴水、石阶、铁栅窗、壁灯（熄）、壁灯（亮）、尖拱门楣饰、山墙小尖塔。
extra.en: The 16 cells in order: pointed-arch door closed, pointed-arch door open, stained-glass lancet by day, stained-glass lancet by night (warm light through it), rose window by day, rose window by night, white bell emblem relief, halo sigil relief, stone buttress, simplified beast-head gargoyle, stone steps, barred window, wall lamp off, wall lamp lit, pointed lintel ornament, small gable pinnacle.

items.notes: 彩色玻璃里不画人物与文字，只有几何色块。16 格严格按补充说明的顺序；夜窗与点亮的灯用暖色自发光；招牌只画纹章图形，任何地方都不写字。

subject.zh: 河港仓栈的立面构件：吊货门、木吊杆、滑轮与缆绳，配色取焦油木褐、锈铁与灰石，粗重实用
subject.en: Facade pieces for river harbor warehouses: loading doors, wooden hoist beams, pulleys and ropes, in tarred brown, rusty iron and gray stone, heavy and practical

extra.zh: 16 格依次为：仓库大门（关）、仓库大门（开）、二楼吊货门（关）、二楼吊货门（开）、窄窗（昼）、窄窗（夜，暖光）、吊货木梁与滑轮、一串挂着的缆绳、帆布雨棚、铁皮烟筒、木挑台、鱼纹章招牌、马灯（熄）、马灯（亮）、木门楣、山墙上的吊钩。
extra.en: The 16 cells in order: warehouse door closed, warehouse door open, upper loading door closed, upper loading door open, narrow window by day, narrow window by night (warm light), hoist beam with pulley, hanging coils of rope, canvas awning, tin stovepipe, wooden outrigger platform, fish emblem sign, hurricane lamp off, hurricane lamp lit, timber lintel, gable hook.

items.notes: 16 格严格按补充说明的顺序；夜窗与点亮的灯用暖色自发光；招牌只画纹章图形，任何地方都不写字。

subject.zh: 白钟大教堂的钟楼：灰白石砌的方形钟楼，上部开尖拱钟窗，窗里挂着一口白色的大钟，顶上是鱼鳞石板瓦的八角尖顶，尖顶四角各有一座小尖塔
subject.en: The bell tower of the White Bell Cathedral: a square pale gray stone tower with pointed belfry openings near the top, a great white bell hanging inside, an octagonal fish-scale slate spire above with a small pinnacle at each corner

extra.zh: 约 5 米宽、12 米高（含尖顶）；钟窗正对镜头，白钟清楚可辨。
extra.en: About 5 m wide and 12 m tall including the spire; a belfry opening faces the viewer and the white bell is clearly readable.

items.notes: 底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 鹰丘城堡：北面岩丘上的伯爵城堡，灰石主塔带垛口，塔顶插着伯爵旗，主塔旁一段城墙与一座圆形角楼，岩丘的岩脚露在城堡下方
subject.en: Hawkhill Castle: the count castle on the rocky hill to the north, a crenellated gray stone keep flying the count banner, a stretch of curtain wall and a round corner tower beside it, the rock outcrop showing beneath

extra.zh: 约 8 米宽、12 米高（含岩丘）；岩丘底边贴画面底边；旗帜只画几何纹章。
extra.en: About 8 m wide and 12 m tall including the outcrop; the rock rests on the image bottom; the banner carries a geometric emblem only.

items.notes: 底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 星笔塔与观星台：细高的圆形石塔，塔身开着一排小窗，塔顶是带铜栏杆的平台，平台上架着一具黄铜望远镜与星盘，塔尖细长像一支竖起的笔
subject.en: The Stylus Tower and its observatory: a slender round stone tower with a column of small windows, a platform with a brass railing at the top carrying a brass telescope and an astrolabe, a long thin finial like an upright pen

extra.zh: 约 4 米宽、12 米高；望远镜指向左上方。
extra.en: About 4 m wide and 12 m tall; the telescope points to the upper left.

items.notes: 底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 冠石宫：河心王岛上的王宫正面，浅灰石砌的宫殿，正中一座冠状塔楼，塔顶一圈石雕尖齿像一顶石冠，宫前高台阶上立着一排王旗
subject.en: Crownstone Palace: the front of the royal palace on the river isle, pale gray stone, a crown-shaped tower at the center ringed at the top with carved stone points like a stone crown, a row of royal banners on the high front steps

extra.zh: 约 8 米宽、12 米高；只画正中塔楼与两侧一小段宫墙；王旗只画几何纹章。
extra.en: About 8 m wide and 12 m tall; draw only the central tower and short stretches of palace wall; the banners carry geometric emblems only.

items.notes: 底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 教国的白石灰岩墙：方整的白色石灰岩块 #ddd8cc 错缝砌筑，砌缝细，石面有细小的贝壳化石纹与晒白的痕迹，四方无缝
subject.en: Holy See limestone wall: dressed white limestone blocks #ddd8cc in a staggered bond, fine joints, faint fossil shell patterns and sun-bleached patches, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 白分两三级，不要一片死白。四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 刷白灰的乡村毛石墙：碎石墙外刷着厚厚的白灰 #f2efe6，白灰起伏不平，零星剥落处露出浅黄石块，四方无缝
subject.en: Whitewashed rubble wall of the countryside: rubble masonry under a thick coat of whitewash #f2efe6, the lime lumpy and uneven, a few flaked spots showing pale yellow stone, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 带圣纹饰带的白大理石墙：白大理石 #f8f4e8 墙面每隔约 2 米有一道浅金色 #c9a646 的横向饰带，饰带里刻着连续的光轮图案，四方无缝
subject.en: White marble wall with a sigil band: white marble #f8f4e8 crossed every 2 m or so by a pale gold #c9a646 horizontal frieze carved with a continuous halo pattern, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 光轮是图形，不是神光，不用神光白金。四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 修院高墙：灰白石墙 #b9b3a6 上每隔约 2 米凸出一道扶壁，扶壁画成竖向的亮暗两条，墙面朴素，有雨痕，四方无缝
subject.en: High monastery wall: a pale gray stone wall #b9b3a6 with a buttress projecting every 2 m or so, each drawn as a light and a dark vertical strip, plain face with rain streaks, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 橄榄园的干砌石墙：扁平的浅黄白石片 #ddd8cc 不用灰浆层层干垒，石缝里长着小草与橄榄色的苔，四方无缝
subject.en: Dry stone wall of an olive grove: flat pale yellow-white stones #ddd8cc stacked without mortar, small grasses and olive moss in the joints, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 朝圣客舍的淡黄灰泥墙：温暖的淡黄灰泥 #e6d08a 抹得平整，有细细的抹刀痕与几处小裂纹，阳光晒褪的颜色深浅不一，四方无缝
subject.en: Pale yellow plaster wall of a pilgrim hostel: warm pale yellow plaster #e6d08a smoothly troweled, fine trowel marks and a few hairline cracks, unevenly sun-faded, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 白石穹顶的屋面：浅灰白的铅皮 #ddd8cc 一条条竖向拼接，拼缝处是凸起的细棱，细棱竖直，表面有雨水留下的淡痕，四方无缝
subject.en: Roofing for the white domes: pale gray-white lead #ddd8cc in vertical strips joined by raised standing seams, the seams vertical, faint rain marks, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 穹顶几何由渲染层提供（ROOF_SHAPES 扩展），这里只是表面。瓦行或草层必须水平、屋脊方向在上；不画屋脊与檐口（由条带贴）；生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝。

subject.zh: 乳白陶筒瓦屋面：乳白色陶筒瓦 #ddd8cc 一仰一俯排列，颜色浅而暖，瓦缝浅灰，瓦行水平，四方无缝
subject.en: Cream clay barrel tile roof: cream clay tiles #ddd8cc laid alternately up and down, light and warm, pale gray gaps, rows horizontal, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 瓦行或草层必须水平、屋脊方向在上；不画屋脊与檐口（由条带贴）；生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝。

subject.zh: 金肋白顶：白色屋面 #f2efe6 上每隔约 1 米一道竖向的金色肋条 #c9a646，肋条之间是浅灰白石板，四方无缝
subject.en: Gilded-rib white roof: a white roof #f2efe6 with a vertical gold rib #c9a646 about every 1 m, pale gray-white stone slabs between the ribs, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 瓦行或草层必须水平、屋脊方向在上；不画屋脊与檐口（由条带贴）；生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝。

subject.zh: 平顶露台的石面：浅色方石板 #ddd8cc 铺成的平顶，板缝填着白灰，石面晒得发白，有均匀分布的排水浅槽，四方无缝
subject.en: Flat terrace roof: pale square stone slabs #ddd8cc forming a flat roof, white lime in the joints, sun-bleached faces, evenly spaced shallow drainage grooves, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 瓦行或草层必须水平、屋脊方向在上；不画屋脊与檐口（由条带贴）；生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝。

subject.zh: 教国建筑的墙基、压檐与檐边：白石线脚、金色圣纹带与浅黄石，配色取白、金与橄榄绿，洁净明亮
subject.en: Base, cap and eave trims for Holy See buildings: white stone moldings, gold sigil bands and pale yellow stone in white, gold and olive green, clean and bright

extra.zh: 第 1 行墙基：白石勒脚带一道浅槽；第 2 行墙顶压檐：白石压顶，下沿一排小方齿；第 3 行屋檐封边：白石檐口带金色光轮纹饰带；第 4 行山墙封檐板：白石封檐带浅金卷叶纹。
extra.en: Row 1 wall base: a white stone plinth with a shallow groove; row 2 wall cap: a white stone coping with a row of small dentils; row 3 eave fascia: a white stone cornice with a gold halo frieze; row 4 gable bargeboard: a white stone verge with a pale gold leaf scroll.

items.notes: 4 条之间用洋红隔开；每条的左右两端要能首尾相接；每条上沿留一道亮边。

subject.zh: 教国小镇民居的立面构件：橄榄绿木百叶窗、白石拱门、陶罐花盆与葡萄藤架，配色取白、橄榄绿、浅金与暖黄窗光，明亮洁净
subject.en: Facade pieces for Holy See town houses: olive green shutters, white stone arched doors, clay flower pots and vine trellises, in white, olive green, pale gold and warm window light, bright and clean

extra.zh: 16 格依次为：木门（关）、木门（开）、百叶窗（昼）、百叶窗（夜，暖光）、小窗、圆窗、招牌甲（橄榄枝纹章）、招牌乙（葡萄纹章）、葡萄藤架雨棚、白石烟囱、铁栏小阳台、陶罐花盆（红花）、壁灯（熄）、壁灯（亮）、拱门楣饰、山墙饰（小光轮）。
extra.en: The 16 cells in order: wooden door closed, wooden door open, shuttered window by day, shuttered window by night (warm light), small window, round window, sign A (olive branch emblem), sign B (grape emblem), vine trellis awning, white stone chimney, small iron balcony, clay pot (red flowers), wall lamp off, wall lamp lit, arched lintel ornament, gable ornament (small halo).

items.notes: 16 格严格按补充说明的顺序；夜窗与点亮的灯用暖色自发光；招牌只画纹章图形，任何地方都不写字。

subject.zh: 圣堂的立面构件：白石尖拱门、彩色玻璃窗、金色光轮圣纹与钟窗，彩色玻璃只拼几何色块，配色取白、金与浅蓝
subject.en: Facade pieces for sanctuaries: white stone pointed doors, stained-glass windows, gold halo sigils and belfry openings, the glass only geometric color blocks, in white, gold and pale blue

extra.zh: 16 格依次为：白石拱门（关）、白石拱门（开）、彩色玻璃长窗（昼）、彩色玻璃长窗（夜，暖光）、圆窗（昼）、圆窗（夜）、金色光轮浮雕、披袍圣像壁龛（看不清脸）、白石扶壁、钟窗与小钟、白石台阶、金色栏杆、壁灯（熄）、壁灯（亮）、尖拱门楣饰、山墙小尖塔。
extra.en: The 16 cells in order: white stone arched door closed, white stone arched door open, tall stained-glass window by day, tall stained-glass window by night (warm light), round window by day, round window by night, gold halo relief, niche with a robed statue (face indistinct), white stone buttress, belfry opening with a small bell, white stone steps, gold railing, wall lamp off, wall lamp lit, pointed lintel ornament, small gable pinnacle.

items.notes: 16 格严格按补充说明的顺序；夜窗与点亮的灯用暖色自发光；招牌只画纹章图形，任何地方都不写字。

subject.zh: 修院与朝圣客舍的立面构件：回廊拱、客舍木门、香炉与贝壳纹章，配色取白、淡黄、橄榄绿与暖光，安宁
subject.en: Facade pieces for monasteries and pilgrim hostels: cloister arches, hostel doors, censers and shell emblems, in white, pale yellow, olive green and warm light, peaceful

extra.zh: 16 格依次为：客舍木门（关）、客舍木门（开）、拱窗（昼）、拱窗（夜，暖光）、回廊单拱、回廊双拱、贝壳纹章招牌、钥匙纹章招牌、帆布遮阳、石砌烟囱、木廊、香草花箱、铜香炉挂架（熄）、铜香炉挂架（点燃）、门楣上的小钟、山墙饰（橄榄枝）。
extra.en: The 16 cells in order: hostel door closed, hostel door open, arched window by day, arched window by night (warm light), single cloister arch, double cloister arch, shell emblem sign, key emblem sign, canvas sunshade, stone chimney, wooden gallery, herb flower box, brass censer bracket unlit, brass censer bracket smoking, small bell over the door, gable ornament (olive branch).

items.notes: 16 格严格按补充说明的顺序；夜窗与点亮的灯用暖色自发光；招牌只画纹章图形，任何地方都不写字。

subject.zh: 白冕大圣堂的正立面：白石砌的高大立面，中央一座白石穹顶，穹顶上一圈金色冠状饰，两侧各一座方形钟楼，正门是高大的尖拱门，门上一扇巨大的彩色圆窗
subject.en: The front of the Whitecrown Cathedral: a towering white stone facade, a white dome at the center ringed with a gold crown ornament, a square bell tower on each side, a tall pointed main door with a huge stained-glass rose window above it

extra.zh: 约 8 米宽、12 米高（只画正面的中段）；正面对称。
extra.en: About 8 m wide and 12 m tall (only the central part of the front); symmetrical.

items.notes: 底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 勇者院：白石围墙里的长条学院楼，两层拱廊，正中一座带小穹顶的门楼，门楼上方浮雕一圈光轮，院前一道白石台阶
subject.en: The Hero Academy: a long academy building inside a white stone wall, two stories of arcades, a central gate tower with a small dome and a halo relief above, a flight of white steps in front

extra.zh: 约 8 米宽、9 米高；门楼居中。
extra.en: About 8 m wide and 9 m tall; gate tower centered.

items.notes: 底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 审判庭与静钟堡：灰白石的方正要塞，墙上窗少且窄，顶部一圈垛口，正中一座钟塔，钟窗里的钟被铁链缠住，大门包着铁
subject.en: The tribunal and Stillbell Keep: a square fortress of pale gray stone, few and narrow windows, crenellations all around the top, a bell tower at the center whose bell is bound with iron chains, an iron-clad gate

extra.zh: 约 7 米宽、11 米高；冷峻压抑，与圣堂的明亮相对。
extra.en: About 7 m wide and 11 m tall; grim and oppressive against the brightness of the sanctuaries.

items.notes: 底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 七钟修院的钟楼：细高的白石钟楼分三层，每层开拱窗，窗里错落挂着七口大小不一的铜钟，塔顶是金色的小尖顶
subject.en: The campanile of Seven Bells Abbey: a slender white stone tower in three stages with arched openings, seven bronze bells of different sizes hanging staggered inside, a small gold spire on top

extra.zh: 约 4 米宽、12 米高；七口钟都要看得见。
extra.en: About 4 m wide and 12 m tall; all seven bells visible.

items.notes: 底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 赭红夯土墙：一层层夯实的赭红土 #a85a3a，每层约 15 厘米，层间有水平夯痕，墙面夹着小石子，零星有雨水冲出的浅沟，层行水平，四方无缝
subject.en: Ochre rammed-earth wall: layers of tamped ochre earth #a85a3a about 15 cm each, horizontal ramming lines between them, small pebbles in the mix, a few shallow rain runnels, layers horizontal, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 本包的招牌墙材。四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 赭红砖墙：窄长的赭红砖 #c8784a 一顺一丁砌筑，砖缝麦黄 #e8cf86，砖面有烧制的深浅色差，四方无缝
subject.en: Ochre brick wall: narrow ochre bricks #c8784a in a header and stretcher bond, wheat-yellow joints #e8cf86, kiln color variation, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 长垒的墙面：巨大的钢灰方石 #6a6e74 规整砌筑，每隔几层夹一层赭红砖带，石面有风雨侵蚀的坑点与刀箭痕，厚重严整，四方无缝
subject.en: Face of the Long Rampart: huge steel-gray blocks #6a6e74 laid regularly with an ochre brick band every few courses, faces pitted by weather and scarred by blades and arrows, massive and orderly, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 竞技场看台的石墙：浅赭黄方石 #d8b45a 砌成，每隔约 2 米一道浅浮雕的竖向壁柱，壁柱之间是半圆拱的浅浮雕，四方无缝
subject.en: Arena stand wall: pale ochre-yellow blocks #d8b45a with a shallow upright pilaster every 2 m or so and blind round arches in low relief between them, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 斯克里瓦学城的冷灰石墙：方整的冷灰石块 #8e9298 砌筑，石面平整，石缝里长着细苔，墙上爬着几根常春藤，素雅安静，四方无缝
subject.en: Cool gray stone wall of Scriva: dressed cool gray blocks #8e9298, flat faces, fine moss in the joints, a few ivy runners climbing it, quiet and plain, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 军营的木板墙：横钉的厚木板 #7a6a4a 刷过赭红色但已褪色，木板上烙着一枚三角形的军团印记，钉头成行，四方无缝
subject.en: Legion barracks plank wall: thick horizontal boards #7a6a4a once painted ochre red and now faded, branded with a triangular legion mark, nail heads in neat rows, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 印记是几何三角，不是数字或字母。四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 赭红筒瓦屋面：赭红色的半圆筒瓦 #a85a3a 排列整齐，瓦行水平，每行下沿一道暗线，瓦色深浅变化很小，严整，四方无缝
subject.en: Ochre barrel tile roof: ochre half-round tiles #a85a3a in strict rows, a dark line under each horizontal row, very little color variation, orderly, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 瓦行或草层必须水平、屋脊方向在上；不画屋脊与檐口（由条带贴）；生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝。

subject.zh: 制式营帐的帆布顶：厚实的麦黄帆布 #d8b45a 按固定宽度拼缝，缝线笔直，布面平整，有几处钢灰色补丁，布幅水平，四方无缝
subject.en: Standard legion tent canvas: heavy wheat-yellow canvas #d8b45a sewn in panels of fixed width with straight seams, taut, a few steel-gray patches, panels horizontal, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 瓦行或草层必须水平、屋脊方向在上；不画屋脊与檐口（由条带贴）；生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝。

subject.zh: 学城的青瓦屋面：青灰色平瓦 #6a6e74 错缝叠铺，瓦面有细苔，瓦行水平，四方无缝
subject.en: Blue-gray tile roof of the scholar city: flat blue-gray tiles #6a6e74 in a staggered lap, thin moss on them, rows horizontal, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 瓦行或草层必须水平、屋脊方向在上；不画屋脊与檐口（由条带贴）；生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝。

subject.zh: 皇城的钢灰石板瓦：深钢灰的长方石板瓦 #3a3e44 错缝叠铺，瓦面平整有冷光，瓦行水平，四方无缝
subject.en: Steel-gray slate of the imperial city: dark steel-gray rectangular slates #3a3e44 in a staggered lap, flat with a cold sheen, rows horizontal, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 瓦行或草层必须水平、屋脊方向在上；不画屋脊与檐口（由条带贴）；生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝。

subject.zh: 帝国建筑的墙基、压檐与檐边：钢灰方石、赭红砖带与麦黄线脚，配色取赭红、钢灰与麦黄，横平竖直
subject.en: Base, cap and eave trims for imperial buildings: steel-gray ashlar, ochre brick bands and wheat-yellow moldings in ochre red, steel gray and wheat yellow, strictly level and plumb

extra.zh: 第 1 行墙基：钢灰方石勒脚；第 2 行墙顶压檐：一道赭红砖带夹在两道石线之间；第 3 行屋檐封边：钢灰石檐口带一排方齿；第 4 行山墙封檐板：赭红木封檐带麦穗浮雕。
extra.en: Row 1 wall base: a steel-gray ashlar plinth; row 2 wall cap: an ochre brick band between two stone lines; row 3 eave fascia: a steel-gray stone cornice with a row of dentils; row 4 gable bargeboard: an ochre timber verge with wheat-ear carving.

items.notes: 4 条之间用洋红隔开；每条的左右两端要能首尾相接；每条上沿留一道亮边。

subject.zh: 帝都民居与店铺的立面构件：赭红木门、方格窗、麦穗与车轮纹章招牌，配色取赭红、钢灰、麦黄与暖黄窗光，端正
subject.en: Facade pieces for imperial city houses and shops: ochre wooden doors, square-paned windows, wheat ear and wheel emblem signs, in ochre red, steel gray, wheat yellow and warm window light, upright

extra.zh: 16 格依次为：木门（关）、木门（开）、方格窗（昼）、方格窗（夜，暖光）、小窗、圆窗、麦穗纹章招牌、车轮纹章招牌、麦黄条纹雨棚、砖砌烟囱、木栏阳台、花箱、壁灯（熄）、壁灯（亮）、石门楣饰（月桂）、山墙饰。
extra.en: The 16 cells in order: wooden door closed, wooden door open, square-paned window by day, square-paned window by night (warm light), small window, round window, wheat ear emblem sign, wheel emblem sign, wheat-yellow striped awning, brick chimney, wooden balcony, flower box, wall lamp off, wall lamp lit, stone lintel ornament (laurel), gable ornament.

items.notes: 16 格严格按补充说明的顺序；夜窗与点亮的灯用暖色自发光；招牌只画纹章图形，任何地方都不写字。

subject.zh: 军团营地与要塞的立面构件：包铁营门、射窗、军旗与盾牌架，旗与盾只画几何纹章，配色取钢灰、赭红与麦黄，严整尚武
subject.en: Facade pieces for legion camps and forts: iron-bound gates, firing slits, war banners and shield racks, banners and shields with geometric emblems only, in steel gray, ochre red and wheat yellow, disciplined and martial

extra.zh: 16 格依次为：包铁营门（关）、包铁营门（开）、射窗（昼）、射窗（夜，火光）、窄窗、圆形透气孔、帝国军旗（几何纹章）、连队旗（三角纹）、营帐门帘（掀开）、铁皮烟筒、哨台、盾牌架（挂三面盾）、火盆壁架（熄）、火盆壁架（燃）、门楣上的月桂与剑浮雕、交叉长枪。
extra.en: The 16 cells in order: iron-bound gate closed, iron-bound gate open, firing slit by day, firing slit by night (firelight), narrow window, round vent, imperial war banner (geometric emblem), company pennant (triangle mark), tent flap pulled open, tin stovepipe, watch platform, shield rack with three shields, brazier bracket unlit, brazier bracket burning, laurel and sword relief over the gate, crossed spears.

items.notes: 16 格严格按补充说明的顺序；夜窗与点亮的灯用暖色自发光；招牌只画纹章图形，任何地方都不写字。

subject.zh: 斯克里瓦学城的立面构件：拱形讲堂门、大格窗、书与羽笔纹章，配色取冷灰、青灰、麦黄与暖光，素雅
subject.en: Facade pieces for Scriva the scholar city: arched lecture hall doors, large paned windows, book and quill emblems, in cool gray, blue-gray, wheat yellow and warm light, understated

extra.zh: 16 格依次为：讲堂拱门（关）、讲堂拱门（开）、大格窗（昼）、大格窗（夜，暖光）、小窗、圆窗、书纹章招牌、羽笔纹章招牌、布雨棚、石砌烟囱、石栏小阳台、窗台盆栽、壁灯（熄）、壁灯（亮）、石门楣饰（翻开的书）、山墙上的日晷（只有刻线）。
extra.en: The 16 cells in order: arched lecture door closed, arched lecture door open, large paned window by day, large paned window by night (warm light), small window, round window, book emblem sign, quill emblem sign, cloth awning, stone chimney, small stone balcony, potted plant on the sill, wall lamp off, wall lamp lit, stone lintel ornament (open book), sundial on the gable (tick marks only).

items.notes: 16 格严格按补充说明的顺序；夜窗与点亮的灯用暖色自发光；招牌只画纹章图形，任何地方都不写字。

subject.zh: 格兰提亚皇宫的正门：赭红砖与钢灰石砌的宏大门楼，两座方塔夹着高大的拱门，塔顶插着帝国军旗，门楼上方一排石雕月桂与盾
subject.en: The main gate of the Grantia imperial palace: a grand gatehouse of ochre brick and steel-gray stone, two square towers flanking a tall arched gate, imperial banners on the towers, a row of carved laurels and shields above the gate

extra.zh: 约 8 米宽、12 米高；正面对称；军旗只画几何纹章。
extra.en: About 8 m wide and 12 m tall; symmetrical; banners with geometric emblems only.

items.notes: 底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 钟塔与星象台：赭红砖砌的方形钟塔，塔身嵌着一面大钟盘，塔顶是一座带铜栏杆的小平台与一具黄铜星象仪
subject.en: The clock tower observatory: a square ochre brick clock tower with a large clock face set into it, a small platform with a brass railing on top carrying a brass orrery

extra.zh: 约 4 米宽、12 米高；钟盘只画指针与刻线，没有数字。
extra.en: About 4 m wide and 12 m tall; the clock face shows only hands and tick marks, no numerals.

items.notes: 底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 斯克里瓦学院总院：冷灰石砌的宽大讲堂，正面一排高大的拱窗，中央门楼上方是一座青瓦小钟塔，屋檐下蹲着几只衔着纸页的乌鸦
subject.en: The great hall of the Scriva academy: a broad lecture hall of cool gray stone, a row of tall arched windows across the front, a small blue-tiled bell tower above the central entrance, a few crows holding scraps of paper perched under the eaves

extra.zh: 约 8 米宽、10 米高；纸页是空白的。
extra.en: About 8 m wide and 10 m tall; the paper scraps are blank.

items.notes: 底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 帝都大竞技场的一段外墙：浅赭黄方石砌的圆弧外墙，两层拱廊叠在一起，拱里透出暗处，顶层插着一排彩色三角旗
subject.en: A stretch of the outer wall of the imperial grand arena: a curved wall of pale ochre-yellow stone, two tiers of arcades one above the other with darkness inside the arches, a row of colored pennants along the top

extra.zh: 约 8 米宽、10 米高；只画外墙的一段，弧形向两侧后退。
extra.en: About 8 m wide and 10 m tall; only one stretch of the wall, curving away on both sides.

items.notes: 底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 港城的暖色灰泥墙：橘红偏粉的灰泥 #d4895a 抹得平整，墙面晒褪成深浅不一的暖色块，几处剥落露出浅色底灰，四方无缝
subject.en: Warm stucco wall of the harbor cities: pinkish orange plaster #d4895a smoothly applied, sun-faded into patches of warmer and paler tone, a few flaked spots showing the pale undercoat, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 港堤与仓栈的灰褐方石墙：被海风磨圆的灰褐方石 #8a7a5a 错缝砌筑，石缝里结着白盐，石面挂着均匀分布的暗绿海苔痕，四方无缝
subject.en: Gray-brown ashlar of quays and warehouses: gray-brown blocks #8a7a5a rounded by the sea wind in a staggered bond, white salt crusted in the joints, evenly spread dark green sea moss stains, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 仓栈的深褐木墙：横钉的厚木板 #6b4f1d，板缝用焦油麻絮封住，钉着一排排锈铁扣，木面有绳磨痕，四方无缝
subject.en: Dark brown warehouse timber wall: thick horizontal boards #6b4f1d, seams sealed with tarred oakum, rows of rusty iron clamps, rope wear on the wood, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 刷成海蓝的灰泥墙：白灰泥上刷了一层海蓝色 #2e6e9a，蓝漆被晒得斑驳，露出底下的白，颜色在深蓝与浅蓝之间变化，四方无缝
subject.en: Sea-blue painted plaster wall: white plaster painted sea blue #2e6e9a, the paint sun-mottled to show white beneath, shifting between deep and pale blue, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 交易所的米白大理石墙：米白大理石 #f0e6d0 大块对缝砌筑，石面有暖黄色细纹，每隔约 2 米一道浅浮雕的竖向壁柱，四方无缝
subject.en: Cream marble wall of the exchange: large cream marble blocks #f0e6d0 joint to joint, warm yellow veining, a shallow upright pilaster every 2 m or so, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 沉港的潮间残墙：被海水泡黑的旧石墙 #3a3e44，墙面满是均匀分布的白色藤壶与海藻，石缝里嵌着贝壳，四方无缝
subject.en: Tidal ruin wall of the sunken harbor: old stone #3a3e44 blackened by the sea, evenly covered with white barnacles and seaweed, shells lodged in the joints, seamless on all sides

items.notes: D3-2 沉船湾用。四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 同盟港城的赤陶筒瓦：橘红赤陶筒瓦 #b5643a 一仰一俯排列，瓦色在橘红与浅陶 #d4895a 之间变化，瓦行水平，四方无缝
subject.en: Terracotta barrel tiles of the League harbor towns: orange-red tiles #b5643a laid alternately up and down, varying between orange red and pale clay #d4895a, rows horizontal, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 本包最常用的屋面。瓦行或草层必须水平、屋脊方向在上；不画屋脊与檐口（由条带贴）；生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝。

subject.zh: 铜绿屋面：拼接的铜板屋面被海风锈成青绿色，接缝是竖向的凸棱，颜色在青绿与旧铜金 #c9a227 之间斑驳，四方无缝
subject.en: Verdigris copper roof: seamed copper sheets weathered by sea air to blue-green, vertical standing seams, mottled between blue-green and old copper gold #c9a227, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 本包锚色没有绿，量化后会偏海蓝，这是可以的。瓦行或草层必须水平、屋脊方向在上；不画屋脊与檐口（由条带贴）；生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝。

subject.zh: 市集雨棚的帆布顶：海蓝 #2e6e9a 与米白 #f0e6d0 宽条纹相间的帆布，布面有绳孔与补丁，条纹竖直，四方无缝
subject.en: Sailcloth market awning roof: canvas in broad stripes of sea blue #2e6e9a and cream #f0e6d0, grommets and patches, stripes vertical, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 瓦行或草层必须水平、屋脊方向在上；不画屋脊与檐口（由条带贴）；生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝。

subject.zh: 商馆的平顶露台：赤陶方砖 #b5643a 铺成的平顶，砖缝填着白灰，有均匀分布的排水浅槽，四方无缝
subject.en: Flat terrace roof of merchant houses: square terracotta pavers #b5643a forming a flat roof, white lime joints, evenly spaced shallow drainage grooves, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 瓦行或草层必须水平、屋脊方向在上；不画屋脊与檐口（由条带贴）；生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝。

subject.zh: 同盟港城建筑的墙基、压檐与檐边：灰褐方石、米白线脚与海蓝木檐，配色取海蓝、赤陶、米白与金
subject.en: Base, cap and eave trims for League harbor buildings: gray-brown ashlar, cream moldings and sea-blue timber eaves in sea blue, terracotta, cream and gold

extra.zh: 第 1 行墙基：灰褐方石勒脚，结着盐霜；第 2 行墙顶压檐：米白石压顶；第 3 行屋檐封边：海蓝木封檐板，下沿一排金色小铜钉；第 4 行山墙封檐板：海蓝木封檐带白色波浪纹。
extra.en: Row 1 wall base: a gray-brown ashlar plinth crusted with salt; row 2 wall cap: a cream stone coping; row 3 eave fascia: a sea-blue timber fascia with a row of small gold brass studs; row 4 gable bargeboard: a sea-blue bargeboard with a white wave pattern.

items.notes: 4 条之间用洋红隔开；每条的左右两端要能首尾相接；每条上沿留一道亮边。

subject.zh: 商馆与民居的立面构件：海蓝木百叶窗、拱门、天平与钱币纹章招牌，配色取海蓝、赤陶、米白、金与暖黄窗光，富足
subject.en: Facade pieces for merchant houses and homes: sea-blue shutters, arched doors, scales and coin emblem signs, in sea blue, terracotta, cream, gold and warm window light, prosperous

extra.zh: 16 格依次为：木门（关）、木门（开）、百叶窗（昼）、百叶窗（夜，暖光）、小窗、圆窗、天平纹章招牌、钱币纹章招牌、条纹帆布雨棚、陶砌烟囱、铁栏阳台、花箱（橙花）、壁灯（熄）、壁灯（亮）、拱门楣饰（贝壳）、山墙饰（帆船剪影）。
extra.en: The 16 cells in order: wooden door closed, wooden door open, shuttered window by day, shuttered window by night (warm light), small window, round window, scales emblem sign, coin emblem sign, striped canvas awning, terracotta chimney, iron balcony, flower box (orange flowers), wall lamp off, wall lamp lit, arched lintel ornament (shell), gable ornament (sailing ship silhouette).

items.notes: 16 格严格按补充说明的顺序；夜窗与点亮的灯用暖色自发光；招牌只画纹章图形，任何地方都不写字。

subject.zh: 港口仓栈与码头的立面构件：吊货门、木吊杆、缆绳、锚纹章与鱼纹章，配色取焦油木褐、海蓝、锈铁与米白
subject.en: Facade pieces for harbor warehouses and wharves: loading doors, hoist beams, ropes, anchor and fish emblems, in tarred brown, sea blue, rusty iron and cream

extra.zh: 16 格依次为：仓库大门（关）、仓库大门（开）、二楼吊货门（关）、二楼吊货门（开）、窄窗（昼）、窄窗（夜，暖光）、吊货木梁与滑轮、一圈缆绳、锚纹章招牌、鱼纹章招牌、帆布雨棚、铁皮烟筒、马灯（熄）、马灯（亮）、木门楣、挂在墙上的软木浮环。
extra.en: The 16 cells in order: warehouse door closed, warehouse door open, upper loading door closed, upper loading door open, narrow window by day, narrow window by night (warm light), hoist beam with pulley, a coil of rope, anchor emblem sign, fish emblem sign, canvas awning, tin stovepipe, hurricane lamp off, hurricane lamp lit, timber lintel, a cork float ring hung on the wall.

items.notes: 16 格严格按补充说明的顺序；夜窗与点亮的灯用暖色自发光；招牌只画纹章图形，任何地方都不写字。

subject.zh: 交易所与梅尔卡神殿的立面构件：石柱拱廊、铜门、天平与钱币浮雕、金色饰带，配色取米白、金与海蓝，庄重富丽
subject.en: Facade pieces for the exchange and the temple of Merca: columned arcades, bronze doors, scales and coin reliefs, gold friezes, in cream, gold and sea blue, stately and rich

extra.zh: 16 格依次为：铜门（关）、铜门（开）、拱窗（昼）、拱窗（夜，暖光）、单拱廊、双拱廊、天平浮雕、钱币浮雕、帆布遮阳、石砌烟囱、石栏阳台、一段金色饰带、铜灯（熄）、铜灯（亮）、门楣饰（金秤）、山墙饰（硬币环）。
extra.en: The 16 cells in order: bronze door closed, bronze door open, arched window by day, arched window by night (warm light), single arcade bay, double arcade bay, scales relief, coin relief, canvas sunshade, stone chimney, stone balcony, a length of gold frieze, bronze lamp off, bronze lamp lit, lintel ornament (golden scales), gable ornament (ring of coins).

items.notes: 钱币上不画面值与字。16 格严格按补充说明的顺序；夜窗与点亮的灯用暖色自发光；招牌只画纹章图形，任何地方都不写字。

subject.zh: 金湾交易所：米白大理石的正面，六根石柱撑起三角楣，楣上浮雕一杆巨大的金色天平，柱廊后是高大的铜门，台阶宽阔
subject.en: The Goldbay Exchange: a cream marble front, six columns carrying a pediment with a huge gold scales relief, tall bronze doors behind the colonnade, broad steps

extra.zh: 约 8 米宽、9 米高；正面对称；天平只是图形。
extra.en: About 8 m wide and 9 m tall; symmetrical; the scales are only a shape.

items.notes: 底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 梅尔卡大神殿：米白与海蓝相间的神殿，正中一座铜绿穹顶，穹顶上立一枚金色硬币环饰，正门是包金铜门，门两侧各一盏高大的铜灯
subject.en: The great temple of Merca: a temple banded in cream and sea blue, a verdigris dome at the center topped by a gold ring of coins, gilded bronze main doors, a tall bronze lamp on each side

extra.zh: 约 8 米宽、12 米高。
extra.en: About 8 m wide and 12 m tall.

items.notes: 底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 金冠商行的商馆：四层的暖色灰泥楼，海蓝百叶窗，底层是石柱拱廊，顶层一座小塔楼挂着金冠纹章旗，二楼伸出吊货木梁
subject.en: The Goldcrown trading house: a four-story warm stucco building, sea-blue shutters, a columned arcade at street level, a small tower on top flying a gold crown emblem banner, a hoist beam projecting from the second floor

extra.zh: 约 7 米宽、12 米高；纹章只画金冠图形。
extra.en: About 7 m wide and 12 m tall; the emblem is only a gold crown shape.

items.notes: 底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 沉船湾的潮门拱：半没在泥滩里的巨大古石拱，拱石上满是藤壶与海藻，拱顶刻着一道浅浅的门形纹，拱下积着潮水退去后的湿泥
subject.en: The tide gate arch of Wreck Bay: a huge ancient stone arch half sunk in the mudflat, its voussoirs covered in barnacles and seaweed, a shallow door-shaped pattern carved at the crown, wet mud left by the ebb beneath it

extra.zh: 约 8 米宽、9 米高；不画水面，拱脚截在泥里。
extra.en: About 8 m wide and 9 m tall; no water, the arch feet cut off in the mud.

items.notes: 底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 精灵树屋的银树皮墙：活树的银灰树皮 #a8b4bc 纵向纹理细长，树皮间嵌着淡绿苔，偶有一道发光的细银纹，纹理竖直，四方无缝
subject.en: Silver bark wall of elven treehouses: living silver-gray bark #a8b4bc with long fine vertical grain, pale green moss between the plates, an occasional thin glowing silver line, grain vertical, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 活木编成的墙：一根根仍在生长的细树干 #7a6a52 并排竖立，枝条横向编连，枝上长着几片新叶，缝里透出淡淡的光，四方无缝
subject.en: Woven living-wood wall: slender still-growing trunks #7a6a52 standing side by side, branches woven across them, a few new leaves sprouting, faint light through the gaps, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 藤编格墙：深绿的藤条 #2e5a3a 编成菱形格，格间挂着小叶与白色小花，透出后面的暗绿，四方无缝
subject.en: Vine lattice wall: deep green vines #2e5a3a woven into a diamond lattice hung with small leaves and white flowers, dark green showing behind, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 根下石室的苔石墙：圆润的灰石 #a8b4bc 被细根网住，石缝塞满苔，根在石面上蜿蜒，四方无缝
subject.en: Mossy stone wall of the root chambers: rounded gray stones #a8b4bc netted with fine roots, moss packed in the joints, roots winding over the faces, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 雕刻的心材墙板：浅褐心材 #7a6a52 打磨光滑，刻着连续的年轮与叶脉纹，纹样均匀重复，四方无缝
subject.en: Carved heartwood panels: pale brown heartwood #7a6a52 polished smooth and carved with continuous growth-ring and leaf-vein patterns repeating evenly, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 长苔的木板墙：银灰木板 #b8c8b0 竖向拼接，木板上长着厚苔与小蘑菇，板缝里冒出细根，四方无缝
subject.en: Moss-grown plank wall: silver-gray boards #b8c8b0 joined vertically, thick moss and tiny mushrooms growing on them, fine roots poking out of the seams, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 叶瓦屋面：一片片大叶形的木瓦 #4a7a4a 像鱼鳞一样叠铺，叶脉清楚，深浅两绿，瓦行水平，四方无缝
subject.en: Leaf tile roof: large leaf-shaped wooden tiles #4a7a4a lapped like scales, clear veins, two greens, rows horizontal, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 本包最常用的屋面。瓦行或草层必须水平、屋脊方向在上；不画屋脊与檐口（由条带贴）；生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝。

subject.zh: 苔顶屋面：厚厚的苔层 #2e5a3a 覆盖在枝条屋面上，苔上长着小花与蕨芽，层次水平，四方无缝
subject.en: Moss thatch roof: a thick moss layer #2e5a3a over a woven branch roof, small flowers and fern shoots growing in it, courses horizontal, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 瓦行或草层必须水平、屋脊方向在上；不画屋脊与檐口（由条带贴）；生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝。

subject.zh: 银树皮瓦：剥下的银灰树皮片 #b8c8b0 错缝叠铺，表面有细长的纵纹，瓦行水平，四方无缝
subject.en: Silver bark shingles: stripped silver-gray bark pieces #b8c8b0 in a staggered lap, long fine grain on each, rows horizontal, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 瓦行或草层必须水平、屋脊方向在上；不画屋脊与檐口（由条带贴）；生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝。

subject.zh: 林冠编织顶：细枝与宽叶 #7aa06a 编成的屋面，编纹是交错的人字，叶间透出点点浅色，四方无缝
subject.en: Woven canopy roof: thin twigs and broad leaves #7aa06a woven into a herringbone, small pale gaps between the leaves, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 瓦行或草层必须水平、屋脊方向在上；不画屋脊与檐口（由条带贴）；生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝。

subject.zh: 精灵建筑的墙基、压檐与檐边：盘根、活枝、银饰包边与藤，线条柔和弯曲，没有一处直角，配色取深绿、银与雾白
subject.en: Base, cap and eave trims for elven buildings: living wood, silver fittings and vines with soft curving lines in deep green, silver and mist white

extra.zh: 第 1 行墙基：盘绕的树根勒脚；第 2 行墙顶压檐：一根带叶的活枝压顶；第 3 行屋檐封边：银饰包边的木封檐，挂着一排小灵萤灯罩；第 4 行山墙封檐板：刻着叶脉纹的弯木封檐。
extra.en: Row 1 wall base: a plinth of coiling roots; row 2 wall cap: a living leafy branch along the top; row 3 eave fascia: a silver-edged timber fascia with a row of small glowfly lantern shades; row 4 gable bargeboard: a curved timber verge carved with leaf veins.

items.notes: 4 条之间用洋红隔开；每条的左右两端要能首尾相接；每条上沿留一道亮边。

subject.zh: 精灵树屋的立面构件：圆门、圆窗、藤帘与灵萤灯，线条圆润，配色取银、深绿、雾白与浅青灯光
subject.en: Facade pieces for elven treehouses: round doors, round windows, vine curtains and glowfly lamps with rounded lines, in silver, deep green, mist white and pale blue lamplight

extra.zh: 16 格依次为：圆木门（关）、圆木门（开）、圆窗（昼）、圆窗（夜，浅青光）、叶形小窗、椭圆窗、藤帘（垂下）、藤帘（挽起）、叶片雨棚、细木烟道、藤栏小阳台、花篮（白花）、灵萤灯（熄）、灵萤灯（亮）、门楣上的银叶饰、山墙上的年轮纹。
extra.en: The 16 cells in order: round wooden door closed, round wooden door open, round window by day, round window by night (pale blue light), small leaf-shaped window, oval window, vine curtain hanging, vine curtain tied back, leaf awning, slender wooden flue, small vine-railed balcony, flower basket (white flowers), glowfly lamp off, glowfly lamp lit, silver leaf over the door, growth rings on the gable.

items.notes: 浅青灯光代替暖黄窗光，这是本包的夜窗颜色。16 格严格按补充说明的顺序；夜窗与点亮的灯用暖色自发光；招牌只画纹章图形，任何地方都不写字。

subject.zh: 环木议庭的立面构件：嵌在巨树上的议事门、雕纹木板与银灯，配色取银、浅褐与深绿，古老庄重
subject.en: Facade pieces for Ringwood Court: council doors set into the giant trees, carved boards and silver lamps, in silver, pale brown and deep green, ancient and dignified

extra.zh: 16 格依次为：议事大门（关）、议事大门（开）、高窗（昼）、高窗（夜，浅青光）、年轮纹雕板、叶脉纹雕板、氏族纹章（叶与弓）、氏族纹章（叶与泉）、藤廊顶、银灯链、树上平台栏杆、悬挂的种子串、银灯（熄）、银灯（亮）、门楣上的环形年轮、山墙上的交叉枝。
extra.en: The 16 cells in order: council door closed, council door open, high window by day, high window by night (pale blue light), growth-ring carved board, leaf-vein carved board, clan emblem (leaf and bow), clan emblem (leaf and spring), vine arbor roof, silver lamp chain, platform railing, hanging string of seeds, silver lamp off, silver lamp lit, ring of growth rings over the door, crossed boughs on the gable.

items.notes: 16 格严格按补充说明的顺序；夜窗与点亮的灯用暖色自发光；招牌只画纹章图形，任何地方都不写字。

subject.zh: 深根谷根下庭的立面构件：嵌在根间的石门、根帘与苔灯，配色取灰石、苔绿与温暖的烛光，隐蔽安静
subject.en: Facade pieces for the Rootcourt of Deeproot Vale: stone doors set between roots, root curtains and moss lamps, in gray stone, moss green and warm candlelight, hidden and quiet

extra.zh: 16 格依次为：石门（关）、石门（开）、根缝窗（昼）、根缝窗（夜，暖光）、小石窗、圆形石孔、根帘（垂下）、根帘（掀开）、苔草雨棚、石砌烟道、根桥栏杆、苔盆、苔灯（熄）、苔灯（亮）、门楣上一块刻着弧线的小石、根墙上的石龛。
extra.en: The 16 cells in order: stone door closed, stone door open, window in a root gap by day, by night (warm light), small stone window, round stone porthole, root curtain hanging, root curtain pulled aside, moss and sedge awning, stone flue, root bridge railing, moss pot, moss lamp off, moss lamp lit, a small stone carved with arcs over the door, a stone niche in the root wall.

items.notes: 16 格严格按补充说明的顺序；夜窗与点亮的灯用暖色自发光；招牌只画纹章图形，任何地方都不写字。

subject.zh: 环木：一圈环形生长的巨树中的一段，三棵银灰巨树的树干相连成弧形的墙，树根盘结成台阶，树干上开着树屋的圆窗，高处挂着藤桥
subject.en: The Ringwood: one stretch of the circle of giant trees, three silver-gray trunks fused into a curved wall, roots knotted into steps, round treehouse windows in the trunks, vine bridges high above

extra.zh: 约 8 米宽、12 米高；只画弧形的一段，树冠在画面顶边截断。
extra.en: About 8 m wide and 12 m tall; only one curved stretch, the crowns cut off at the top edge.

items.notes: 底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 依托巨树的环形树屋：银树皮墙、叶瓦屋顶的圆形平台屋绕着树干一圈，平台边是藤栏，一架木梯盘旋而上，屋檐挂着灵萤灯
subject.en: A ring treehouse on a giant tree: a round platform house with silver bark walls and a leaf-tile roof circling the trunk, vine railings along the platform, a wooden stair spiraling up, glowfly lamps under the eaves

extra.zh: 约 8 米宽、10 米高；树干从画面底边升起，平台在中上部。
extra.en: About 8 m wide and 10 m tall; the trunk rises from the image bottom with the platform in the upper middle.

items.notes: 底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 林冠桥：两棵巨树之间的藤木吊桥，桥面是细木板，两侧藤索上挂着银灯与叶片，桥两头连着树上的平台
subject.en: A canopy bridge: a vine and timber suspension bridge between two giant trees, a deck of thin planks, silver lamps and leaves hung from the vine ropes, platforms on the trees at both ends

extra.zh: 约 8 米宽、6 米高；桥呈下垂的弧线，两端树干只画一小段。
extra.en: About 8 m wide and 6 m tall; the bridge sags in a curve, only short pieces of the trunks at the ends.

items.notes: 底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 世界树的树干底部：比城墙还粗的银灰树干，树皮纵纹深如峡谷，巨根拱出地面盘成门洞般的弧，根间长满发光的苔与小白花
subject.en: The base of the World Tree trunk: a silver-gray trunk wider than a city wall, bark furrows as deep as gorges, giant roots arching out of the ground into doorway-like curves, glowing moss and small white flowers between them

extra.zh: 约 8 米宽、12 米高；只画树干底部的一段，左右与上方都截出画面，表现巨大。
extra.en: About 8 m wide and 12 m tall; only the lowest part of the trunk, cut off at both sides and the top to convey immense size.

items.notes: 底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 毡帐的白毡墙：厚实的米白羊毛毡 #e8dcc4 一片片拼成，毡面有压缩的绒纹，拼缝用红绳 #b83a2a 缝合，外面绑着两道横向皮绳，四方无缝
subject.en: White felt wall of the round tents: thick cream wool felt #e8dcc4 in panels, pressed fiber texture, seams stitched with red cord #b83a2a, two horizontal leather straps bound around the outside, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 本包的招牌墙材。四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 染色的部族毡墙：赭黄 #c8b46a 与褐色毡面上贴着红毡剪成的连续几何纹，菱形与兽角纹交替，纹样均匀重复，四方无缝
subject.en: Dyed clan felt wall: ochre-yellow #c8b46a and brown felt appliqued with continuous geometric red felt cutouts, diamonds alternating with beast-horn shapes, the pattern repeating evenly, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 草原营地的木栅：一根根削尖的细木杆 #8a6a4a 竖排，用皮绳横绑三道，杆上挂着几缕彩绳与马尾，四方无缝
subject.en: Steppe camp palisade: thin sharpened poles #8a6a4a set upright, bound with three bands of leather cord, a few colored cords and horsetails tied on, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 兽王台的石墙：粗大的灰褐毛石 #6a6460 干垒，石面刻着简单的兽爪纹与圆圈纹，石缝里长着硬草，四方无缝
subject.en: Stone wall of the beast king dais: large gray-brown fieldstones #6a6460 stacked dry, carved with simple claw and circle marks, wiry grass in the joints, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 刻纹是几何图形。四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 绷皮墙：一张张鞣过的兽皮 #8a6a4a 绷在木框上，皮面有深浅斑纹与缝线，木框竖直，四方无缝
