subject.en: Stretched hide wall: tanned hides #8a6a4a laced onto wooden frames, mottled light and dark with visible stitching, frames upright, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 祖灵冢的草皮土墙：一层层草皮块 #7a8a4a 与暗褐土垒成，草皮朝外，夹着白石块，层次水平，四方无缝
subject.en: Sod wall of the ancestor barrows: courses of turf blocks #7a8a4a and dark brown earth, grass facing out, white stones set among them, courses horizontal, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 毡帐圆顶的毡面：米白厚毡 #e8dcc4 铺成的帐顶，贴图里是平行的竖向毡幅，毡面压着竖向的皮绳，四方无缝
subject.en: Felt for the round tent domes: thick cream felt #e8dcc4 drawn as parallel vertical felt widths, held down by vertical leather cords, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 圆顶与圆锥几何由渲染层提供，这里只是表面。瓦行或草层必须水平、屋脊方向在上；不画屋脊与檐口（由条带贴）；生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝。

subject.zh: 圆锥帐顶的兽皮面：拼缝的褐色兽皮 #8a6a4a，缝线粗大，皮上画着红色的简单兽纹，纹样均匀重复，四方无缝
subject.en: Hide for conical tent roofs: stitched brown hides #8a6a4a with heavy seams, simple red beast motifs painted on, the motifs repeating evenly, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 瓦行或草层必须水平、屋脊方向在上；不画屋脊与檐口（由条带贴）；生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝。

subject.zh: 草皮屋顶：切成块的草皮 #7a8a4a 叠铺，草叶黄绿相间，块间露出黑土边，块行水平，四方无缝
subject.en: Sod roof: blocks of cut turf #7a8a4a laid in courses, yellow and green blades, dark soil showing at the joints, courses horizontal, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 瓦行或草层必须水平、屋脊方向在上；不画屋脊与檐口（由条带贴）；生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝。

subject.zh: 草原芦苇顶：季河边割来的黄芦苇 #c8b46a 扎成束层层压叠，下沿剪齐，层次水平，四方无缝
subject.en: Steppe reed thatch: yellow reeds #c8b46a cut by the seasonal rivers, bundled and laid in overlapping courses with trimmed edges, courses horizontal, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 瓦行或草层必须水平、屋脊方向在上；不画屋脊与檐口（由条带贴）；生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝。

subject.zh: 草原营地建筑的墙基、压檐与檐边：压帐的石块、皮绳、彩绳与兽骨，配色取毡红、米白、草黄与骨白
subject.en: Base, cap and eave trims for steppe camp structures: tent-weight stones, leather cords, colored cords and beast bones in felt red, cream, grass yellow and bone white

extra.zh: 第 1 行墙基：一排压帐的圆石；第 2 行墙顶压檐：缠着彩绳的皮绳带；第 3 行屋檐封边：挂着一排红毡流苏的帐檐；第 4 行山墙封檐板：串着兽骨与铜铃的木杆。
extra.en: Row 1 wall base: a row of round tent-weight stones; row 2 wall cap: a leather cord band wound with colored cords; row 3 eave fascia: a tent hem hung with red felt tassels; row 4 gable bargeboard: a wooden pole strung with beast bones and brass bells.

items.notes: 4 条之间用洋红隔开；每条的左右两端要能首尾相接；每条上沿留一道亮边。

subject.zh: 毡帐的立面构件：红毡门帘、木门框、天窗圈与彩绳，配色取米白、毡红、草黄与暖黄火光，开阔温暖
subject.en: Facade pieces for round felt tents: red felt door curtains, wooden door frames, smoke rings and colored cords, in cream, felt red, grass yellow and warm firelight, open and warm

extra.zh: 16 格依次为：红毡门帘（垂下）、红毡门帘（掀开，帐内火光）、木门（关）、木门（开）、毡窗（昼）、毡窗（夜，暖光）、侧面看的天窗圈、一束彩绳、兽骨挂饰、铜铃、门前的毡毯、马鞍挂架、油灯（熄）、油灯（亮）、门楣上的角兽头骨、帐顶的彩旗。
extra.en: The 16 cells in order: red felt door curtain down, red felt door curtain raised (firelight inside), wooden door closed, wooden door open, felt window by day, felt window by night (warm light), smoke ring seen from the side, a bunch of colored cords, bone charm, brass bell, felt rug before the door, saddle rack, oil lamp off, oil lamp lit, horned beast skull over the door, colored pennant on the tent top.

items.notes: 16 格严格按补充说明的顺序；夜窗与点亮的灯用暖色自发光；招牌只画纹章图形，任何地方都不写字。

subject.zh: 红帐营战营的立面构件：兽皮帐门、木栅门、战旗与兵器架，旗与盾只画几何纹章，配色取毡红、黑褐与骨白，粗犷好战
subject.en: Facade pieces for the Redtent war camp: hide tent doors, palisade gates, war banners and weapon racks, banners and shields with geometric emblems only, in felt red, black-brown and bone white, rugged and warlike

extra.zh: 16 格依次为：兽皮帐门（垂下）、兽皮帐门（掀开）、木栅门（关）、木栅门（开）、射孔、瞭望孔、红色战旗（獠牙纹）、黑色战旗（爪纹）、兽皮遮阳、篝火架、盾牌架（挂三面圆盾）、兵器架（长矛）、火把（熄）、火把（燃）、门楣上的獠牙饰、交叉长矛。
extra.en: The 16 cells in order: hide tent door down, hide tent door raised, palisade gate closed, palisade gate open, arrow loop, spy hole, red war banner (fang mark), black war banner (claw mark), hide sunshade, fire rack, shield rack with three round shields, spear rack, torch out, torch burning, tusk ornament over the gate, crossed spears.

items.notes: 16 格严格按补充说明的顺序；夜窗与点亮的灯用暖色自发光；招牌只画纹章图形，任何地方都不写字。

subject.zh: 祖灵冢与希尔薇派圣地的立面构件：石门、立石、彩绳与风铃，配色取灰石、草绿、白与蓝，安静肃穆
subject.en: Facade pieces for the ancestor barrows and the Sylvie faithful sanctuaries: stone doors, standing stones, colored cords and wind chimes, in gray stone, grass green, white and blue, quiet and reverent

extra.zh: 16 格依次为：石门（关）、石门（开）、墓道小窗（昼）、墓道小窗（夜，烛光）、高立石、矮立石、缠着彩绳的木柱、风铃串、草皮雨棚、香炉、石台边沿、白石堆、灯笼（熄）、灯笼（亮）、门楣上的圆圈纹、门边的抽象人形小石像。
extra.en: The 16 cells in order: stone door closed, stone door open, small tomb window by day, small tomb window by night (candlelight), tall standing stone, short standing stone, wooden post wound with colored cords, string of wind chimes, sod awning, censer, edge of a stone platform, cairn of white stones, lantern off, lantern lit, circle mark over the door, small abstract figure stone by the door.

items.notes: 16 格严格按补充说明的顺序；夜窗与点亮的灯用暖色自发光；招牌只画纹章图形，任何地方都不写字。

subject.zh: 部族的大毡帐：直径约 6 米的圆形毡帐，白毡墙配红毡门帘，帐顶用放射状的皮绳压住，顶上一圈木天窗冒着细烟，门两侧立着挂彩绳的木杆
subject.en: A clan great tent: a round felt tent about 6 m across, white felt walls with a red felt door curtain, the roof held by radiating leather cords, a wooden smoke ring at the top with a thin wisp of smoke, poles hung with colored cords on both sides of the door

extra.zh: 约 7 米宽、6 米高；门正对镜头；这一张是基准配色，四部的配色差异另由外观层换色。
extra.en: About 7 m wide and 6 m tall; the door faces the viewer; this is the base coloring, the four clans recolor it through the look layer.

items.notes: 底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 兽王台：巨岩顶上的圆形石台，台边立着一圈高低不一的立石，台中央是一块空着的宽大石座，石座两侧插着两根挂满彩绳与兽骨的长杆
subject.en: The Beast King Dais: a round stone platform on top of the great rock, a ring of standing stones of uneven height around its edge, a broad empty stone seat at the center flanked by two tall poles hung with colored cords and bones

extra.zh: 约 8 米宽、7 米高；石座空着，不画人。
extra.en: About 8 m wide and 7 m tall; the seat is empty, no people.

items.notes: 底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 会盟大帐：长方形的巨大兽皮帐，由多根木柱撑起，帐顶起伏如连绵的小丘，帐檐挂满四色毡流苏，门前立着四面部族旗
subject.en: The council great tent: a huge rectangular hide tent held up by many poles, its roof rising and falling like low hills, the hem hung with felt tassels in four colors, four clan banners before the entrance

extra.zh: 约 8 米宽、7 米高；四面旗只画几何纹章。
extra.en: About 8 m wide and 7 m tall; the four banners carry geometric emblems only.

items.notes: 底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 祖灵冢的入口：长满草的土丘上嵌着一道由三块巨石搭成的石门框，门内是黑暗的墓道，门前立着两块刻圆圈纹的立石与一堆白石
subject.en: The entrance of the ancestor barrows: a grassy mound with a doorway of three great stones set into it, a dark passage within, two standing stones carved with circles and a cairn of white stones in front

extra.zh: 约 7 米宽、6 米高；墓道里只画黑，不画内部。
extra.en: About 7 m wide and 6 m tall; the passage is plain black inside.

items.notes: 底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 黑岩城的玄武岩墙：方整的黑色玄武岩块 #2e2a2c 错缝砌筑，砌缝填着暗红灰浆 #5a1a16，岩面有细小气孔与冷灰的风化斑，四方无缝
subject.en: Basalt wall of the black city: squared black basalt blocks #2e2a2c in a staggered bond, dark red mortar #5a1a16, fine pores and cold gray weathering spots, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 黑分三级，否则一片死黑。四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 镶黑曜石的宫墙：深黑岩面 #1c1a1a 上每隔约 1 米嵌一条竖向的黑曜石带，石带边缘有冷白的硬边高光，石带之间刻着细角纹，四方无缝
subject.en: Obsidian-inlaid palace wall: deep black stone #1c1a1a with a vertical obsidian strip set about every 1 m, cold white hard-edged highlights along the strips, fine horn patterns carved between them, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 暗红漆木墙：竖向的木板漆成暗红 #8a2a22，漆面有细裂，板缝压着黑铁条，铁条上有角形的铆钉，四方无缝
subject.en: Dark red lacquered timber wall: upright boards lacquered dark red #8a2a22, fine crazing in the lacquer, black iron strips over the joints fixed with horn-shaped rivets, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 温泉浴屋的青白瓷砖墙：方形青白瓷砖 #c8e8e4 对缝贴满墙面，砖缝暗灰，几块砖带着橙色的矿物水渍，被蒸汽熏得斑驳，四方无缝
subject.en: Pale teal tile wall of the hot spring bathhouse: square pale teal-white tiles #c8e8e4 joint to joint, dark gray grout, orange mineral water stains on a few tiles, mottled by steam, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 骨与铁的装饰墙：黑铁板 #45403e 铆接成墙，铁板上按网格钉着骨白色 #d8d0c8 的兽角与骨片饰，纹样均匀重复，四方无缝
subject.en: Bone and iron decorative wall: black iron plates #45403e riveted together, bone-white #d8d0c8 horn and bone ornaments fixed on a regular grid, repeating evenly, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 山地堡的碎岩墙：灰黑的碎岩块 #5e5652 用暗红灰浆粗砌，岩块大小不一，墙面挂着灰绿地衣，四方无缝
subject.en: Rubble wall of the highland forts: gray-black broken rock #5e5652 roughly set in dark red mortar, uneven block sizes, gray-green lichen over the face, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 尖檐黑瓦屋面：小块黑陶瓦 #1c1a1a 错缝叠铺，每块瓦的下沿收成尖角，瓦面有暗光，瓦行水平，四方无缝
subject.en: Black pointed tile roof: small black clay tiles #1c1a1a in a staggered lap, each tile ending in a point at its lower edge, a dull sheen, rows horizontal, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 本包最常用的屋面。瓦行或草层必须水平、屋脊方向在上；不画屋脊与檐口（由条带贴）；生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝。

subject.zh: 夹暗红瓦的黑石板屋面：深灰黑的石板瓦 #2e2a2c 错缝叠铺，每隔几行夹一行暗红色 #8a2a22 的瓦，瓦行水平，四方无缝
subject.en: Black slate roof banded with dark red: dark gray-black slates #2e2a2c in a staggered lap with a row of dark red #8a2a22 tiles every few rows, rows horizontal, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 瓦行或草层必须水平、屋脊方向在上；不画屋脊与檐口（由条带贴）；生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝。

subject.zh: 黑铁皮屋面：铆接的黑铁皮 #45403e 竖向拼接，接缝是凸起的铆钉棱，铁皮带着锈红与烧蓝的斑，四方无缝
subject.en: Black sheet iron roof: riveted black iron sheets #45403e joined vertically with raised riveted seams, patches of rust red and heat bluing, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 瓦行或草层必须水平、屋脊方向在上；不画屋脊与檐口（由条带贴）；生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝。

subject.zh: 浴屋的青釉瓦屋面：青白釉的筒瓦 #8ac8c4 一仰一俯排列，釉面被蒸汽熏出深浅的水痕，瓦行水平，四方无缝
subject.en: Teal glazed roof of the bathhouses: pale teal glazed barrel tiles #8ac8c4 laid alternately up and down, steam-marked light and dark streaks on the glaze, rows horizontal, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 瓦行或草层必须水平、屋脊方向在上；不画屋脊与檐口（由条带贴）；生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝。

subject.zh: 黑岩城建筑的墙基、压檐与檐边：黑岩、暗红漆、黑铁与骨饰，配色取黑、暗红与骨白，幽暗富丽
subject.en: Base, cap and eave trims for the black basalt cities: black rock, dark red lacquer, black iron and bone ornaments in black, dark red and bone white, dark and opulent

extra.zh: 第 1 行墙基：黑岩勒脚，嵌一道暗红石带；第 2 行墙顶压檐：黑岩压顶，下沿一排小角饰；第 3 行屋檐封边：暗红漆木封檐，挂着一排小铁铃；第 4 行山墙封檐板：黑铁封檐，端部翘起成角形。
extra.en: Row 1 wall base: a black rock plinth with a dark red stone band; row 2 wall cap: a black rock coping with a row of small horn ornaments; row 3 eave fascia: a dark red lacquered fascia with a row of small iron bells; row 4 gable bargeboard: a black iron verge whose ends curl up into horns.

items.notes: 4 条之间用洋红隔开；每条的左右两端要能首尾相接；每条上沿留一道亮边。

subject.zh: 黑岩城民居与店铺的立面构件：黑铁包边的门、尖拱窗、暗红灯笼与骨饰招牌，配色取黑、暗红、骨白与暖红窗光
subject.en: Facade pieces for black city houses and shops: iron-edged doors, pointed windows, dark red lanterns and bone emblem signs, in black, dark red, bone white and warm red window light

extra.zh: 16 格依次为：黑铁包边木门（关）、黑铁包边木门（开）、尖拱窗（昼）、尖拱窗（夜，暗红暖光）、小窗、圆窗、交叉骨纹章招牌、铁砧纹章招牌、暗红布雨棚、黑岩烟囱、黑铁栏阳台、铁花箱（暗红花）、暗红灯笼（熄）、暗红灯笼（亮）、门楣上的角饰、山墙上的翘角。
extra.en: The 16 cells in order: iron-edged wooden door closed, iron-edged wooden door open, pointed window by day, pointed window by night (dark red warm light), small window, round window, crossed bones emblem sign, anvil emblem sign, dark red cloth awning, black rock chimney, black iron balcony, iron flower box (dark red flowers), dark red lantern off, dark red lantern lit, horn ornament over the door, upturned horn on the gable.

items.notes: 16 格严格按补充说明的顺序；夜窗与点亮的灯用暖色自发光；招牌只画纹章图形，任何地方都不写字。

subject.zh: 暗夜王宫的立面构件：黑曜石镶边的大门、高窄尖窗、角冠浮雕与暗红垂幔，配色取黑、暗红、骨白与银，威严
subject.en: Facade pieces for the night palace: obsidian-edged great doors, tall narrow pointed windows, horned crown reliefs and dark red drapes, in black, dark red, bone white and silver, imposing

extra.zh: 16 格依次为：宫门（关）、宫门（开）、尖窗（昼）、尖窗（夜，暗红光）、高窄窗、月形圆窗、角冠浮雕、交叉长戟与角饰、暗红垂幔、黑岩烟道、黑铁栏露台、黑曜石柱头、铁烛台（熄）、铁烛台（亮）、门楣上的弯角冠、尖塔小顶。
extra.en: The 16 cells in order: palace door closed, palace door open, pointed window by day, pointed window by night (dark red light), tall narrow window, crescent window, horned crown relief, crossed halberds with horn ornament, dark red drape, black rock flue, black iron terrace railing, obsidian capital, iron candelabrum unlit, iron candelabrum lit, curved horn crown over the door, small spire cap.

items.notes: 16 格严格按补充说明的顺序；夜窗与点亮的灯用暖色自发光；招牌只画纹章图形，任何地方都不写字。

subject.zh: 温泉浴屋与集市的立面构件：青白瓷门框、蒸汽窗、暗红摊棚与灯串，配色取青白、黑与暗红，热闹
subject.en: Facade pieces for hot spring bathhouses and the market: pale teal tiled door frames, steam windows, dark red stall awnings and lantern strings, in pale teal, black and dark red, lively

extra.zh: 16 格依次为：浴屋木门（关）、浴屋木门（开）、蒸汽窗（昼）、蒸汽窗（夜，暖光）、小窗、圆窗、水纹招牌、酒杯招牌、暗红布摊棚、陶烟筒、木廊、一串暗红小灯笼、壁灯（熄）、壁灯（亮）、青白瓷门楣、山墙上的鱼形木饰。
extra.en: The 16 cells in order: bathhouse door closed, bathhouse door open, steam window by day, steam window by night (warm light), small window, round window, water ripple sign, mug sign, dark red cloth stall awning, clay chimney pot, wooden gallery, a string of small dark red lanterns, wall lamp off, wall lamp lit, pale teal tiled lintel, fish-shaped wooden ornament on the gable.

items.notes: 16 格严格按补充说明的顺序；夜窗与点亮的灯用暖色自发光；招牌只画纹章图形，任何地方都不写字。

subject.zh: 暗夜王宫的正门：黑色玄武岩的高大宫门，两座细高的尖塔夹着门，塔顶是弯角形的冠饰，门上嵌着黑曜石与暗红的角冠浮雕，门前两盏高大的铁灯
subject.en: The main gate of the night throne palace: a towering black basalt gate flanked by two slender spires topped with curved horn crowns, obsidian and dark red horned crown reliefs set above the door, two tall iron lamps before it

extra.zh: 约 8 米宽、12 米高；正面对称。
extra.en: About 8 m wide and 12 m tall; symmetrical.

items.notes: 底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 温泉浴屋：黑岩基座上的青釉瓦木屋，屋檐翘成角形，檐下挂一串暗红灯笼，屋侧的石槽冒着白汽，门前是青白瓷砖台阶
subject.en: A hot spring bathhouse: a timber house with teal glazed tiles on a black rock base, eaves curling up into horns, a string of dark red lanterns under them, a stone trough at the side giving off white steam, pale teal tiled steps at the door

extra.zh: 约 7 米宽、6 米高；白汽只画两三团硬边汽团，其余交给特效。
extra.en: About 7 m wide and 6 m tall; draw only two or three hard-edged puffs of steam, the rest is an effect.

items.notes: 底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 角冠式黑岩尖塔：细高的黑岩尖塔，塔身开着竖长的暗红窗，塔顶分出三根弯曲的石角像一顶角冠，塔脚是厚重的黑岩基座
subject.en: A horn-crowned black spire: a slender black basalt spire with long narrow dark red windows, its top splitting into three curved stone horns like a horned crown, a heavy black rock base

extra.zh: 约 4 米宽、12 米高。
extra.en: About 4 m wide and 12 m tall.

items.notes: 底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 角冠宫废墟：塌了半边的黑岩宫殿立面，断墙上还挂着褪色的暗红垂幔，一根倒塌的石角横在台阶上，台阶上方是一座空着的高台
subject.en: The ruins of the Horncrown Palace: a black basalt palace front collapsed on one side, faded dark red drapes still hanging from the broken wall, a fallen stone horn lying across the steps, an empty high dais above them

extra.zh: 约 8 米宽、9 米高；高台空着。
extra.en: About 8 m wide and 9 m tall; the dais is empty.

items.notes: 底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 山间石屋的厚毛石墙：灰蓝色的毛石 #5a6670 粗砌，石块大而扁，砌缝塞着苔与碎石，石面有冰冻留下的白色碱斑，四方无缝
subject.en: Thick fieldstone wall of mountain huts: blue-gray rubble #5a6670 roughly laid, stones large and flat, moss and chips packed in the joints, white frost-bloom spots on the faces, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 墙面不画积雪，雪由天气层表现。四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 落叶松原木墙：粗壮的落叶松原木 #b8a070 横叠，缝里塞着苔，木面被风雪刷成银灰褐，原木行水平，四方无缝
subject.en: Larch log wall: stout larch logs #b8a070 stacked horizontally, moss in the gaps, the wood scoured silver-brown by wind and snow, rows horizontal, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 冰洞的冰墙：半透明的冰蓝冰层 #7aa0c4 一层层叠起，冰里冻着气泡与灰色碎石，层次水平，四方无缝
subject.en: Ice cave wall: translucent ice-blue layers #7aa0c4 stacked one above another, bubbles and gray grit frozen inside, layers horizontal, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 七席石的花岗岩墙：灰白花岗岩 #c8d4dc 大块平砌，石面刻着浅浅的古老弧线与圆点，风化出细坑，四方无缝
subject.en: Granite of the Seven Seats: large gray-white granite blocks #c8d4dc laid level, faint ancient arcs and dots carved into the faces, weathered with fine pits, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 刻纹是几何纹，不是文字。四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 凿进峭壁的岩面墙：灰蓝的天然岩壁 #4a6a8a 带着竖向节理，被凿出平整的面，凿痕成行，岩缝里结着冰，四方无缝
subject.en: Cliff face dressed as a wall: natural blue-gray rock #4a6a8a with vertical jointing, cut flat with rows of chisel marks, ice in the cracks, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 观穹台的砌石墙：整齐的深灰方石 #3a4048 砌筑，石面刻着细细的星点与连线图形，石缝涂着白灰，四方无缝
subject.en: Masonry of the Vaultwatch: neat dark gray ashlar #3a4048, faces carved with fine star dots joined by lines, white lime pointing, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 星点与连线是图形，不是文字或数字。四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 厚石板屋面：厚重的灰板岩石板 #5a6670 错缝叠铺，石板边缘粗糙，缝里长着苔，瓦行水平，四方无缝
subject.en: Heavy stone slab roof: thick gray slate slabs #5a6670 in a staggered lap, rough edges, moss in the gaps, rows horizontal, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 屋面不画积雪。瓦行或草层必须水平、屋脊方向在上；不画屋脊与檐口（由条带贴）；生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝。

subject.zh: 落叶松木瓦：厚木片瓦 #b8a070 错缝叠铺，被风雪刷成银灰褐，瓦面有细裂，瓦行水平，四方无缝
subject.en: Larch shingles: thick wooden shingles #b8a070 in a staggered lap, scoured silver-brown by weather, fine splits, rows horizontal, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 瓦行或草层必须水平、屋脊方向在上；不画屋脊与檐口（由条带贴）；生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝。

subject.zh: 高山草皮顶：草皮块 #6a8a6a 叠在木椽上，草色灰绿，夹着小白花，块行水平，四方无缝
subject.en: Alpine sod roof: turf blocks #6a8a6a laid over rafters, gray-green grass with small white flowers, courses horizontal, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 瓦行或草层必须水平、屋脊方向在上；不画屋脊与檐口（由条带贴）；生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝。

subject.zh: 观穹台穹顶的铅皮屋面：深灰铅皮 #3a4048 竖向拼接，接缝是凸起的细棱，铅皮上刻着均匀分布的细小星点，四方无缝
subject.en: Lead roofing of the observatory dome: dark gray lead #3a4048 in vertical strips with raised seams, small star dots engraved evenly over it, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 瓦行或草层必须水平、屋脊方向在上；不画屋脊与檐口（由条带贴）；生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝。

subject.zh: 眠鳞山地建筑的墙基、压檐与檐边：灰蓝石、落叶松木与风绳，配色取冰蓝、灰与木褐，厚重防风
subject.en: Base, cap and eave trims for Sleepscale mountain buildings: blue-gray stone, larch timber and wind cords in ice blue, gray and wood brown, heavy and windproof

extra.zh: 第 1 行墙基：大块灰蓝石勒脚；第 2 行墙顶压檐：一根落叶松压顶木；第 3 行屋檐封边：厚石板挑檐，下沿一排压檐石；第 4 行山墙封檐板：刻着波纹的落叶松封檐。
extra.en: Row 1 wall base: a plinth of large blue-gray stones; row 2 wall cap: a larch capping timber; row 3 eave fascia: a projecting thick slab eave with a row of weight stones; row 4 gable bargeboard: a larch verge carved with waves.

items.notes: 4 条之间用洋红隔开；每条的左右两端要能首尾相接；每条上沿留一道亮边。

subject.zh: 山间石屋的立面构件：厚木门、带厚百叶的小窗、防风灯与雪鞋，配色取灰蓝、木褐与暖黄窗光，厚重
subject.en: Facade pieces for mountain huts: heavy wooden doors, small windows with thick shutters, storm lanterns and snowshoes, in blue-gray, wood brown and warm window light, heavy

extra.zh: 16 格依次为：厚木门（关）、厚木门（开）、小窗（昼，厚百叶）、小窗（夜，暖光）、更小的透气窗、圆窗、招牌甲（冰镐纹章）、招牌乙（锅纹章）、木雨棚、石砌烟囱、木挑台、挂在墙上的雪鞋、防风灯（熄）、防风灯（亮）、门楣上的一片大龙鳞、山墙上的交叉冰镐。
extra.en: The 16 cells in order: heavy door closed, heavy door open, small window by day (thick shutters), small window by night (warm light), tiny vent window, round window, sign A (ice axe emblem), sign B (cooking pot emblem), wooden awning, stone chimney, timber outrigger, snowshoes hung on the wall, storm lantern off, storm lantern lit, one large dragon scale over the door, crossed ice axes on the gable.

items.notes: 16 格严格按补充说明的顺序；夜窗与点亮的灯用暖色自发光；招牌只画纹章图形，任何地方都不写字。

subject.zh: 山间驿站的立面构件：双开大门、马厩门、风绳与里程石，配色取灰蓝、木褐、彩绳与暖光
subject.en: Facade pieces for mountain way stations: double doors, stable doors, wind cords and milestones, in blue-gray, wood brown, colored cords and warm light

extra.zh: 16 格依次为：双开大门（关）、双开大门（开）、马厩门（关）、马厩门（开）、窗（昼）、窗（夜，暖光）、马蹄铁纹章招牌、山峰纹章招牌、木雨棚、石砌烟囱、木廊、挂着的一束风绳、马灯（熄）、马灯（亮）、木门楣、嵌在墙上只刻圆点的里程石。
extra.en: The 16 cells in order: double door closed, double door open, stable door closed, stable door open, window by day, window by night (warm light), horseshoe emblem sign, mountain peak emblem sign, wooden awning, stone chimney, wooden gallery, a bunch of wind cords, hurricane lamp off, hurricane lamp lit, timber lintel, a milestone set into the wall carved only with dots.

items.notes: 16 格严格按补充说明的顺序；夜窗与点亮的灯用暖色自发光；招牌只画纹章图形，任何地方都不写字。

subject.zh: 七席石与观穹台的立面构件：石门、星点浮雕、窥星孔与风绳柱，配色取灰白、冰蓝与银，古老肃静
subject.en: Facade pieces for the Seven Seats and the Vaultwatch: stone doors, star-dot reliefs, star-gazing ports and wind cord posts, in gray-white, ice blue and silver, ancient and still

extra.zh: 16 格依次为：石门（关）、石门（开）、窥星孔（昼）、窥星孔（夜，暖光）、星点浮雕、弧线浮雕、风绳柱、石灯龛（熄）、石灯龛（亮）、石阶、石栏、一节脊骨形的龙骨雕饰、银铃串、冰蓝石珠、门楣上的七点纹、山墙上的圆盘。
extra.en: The 16 cells in order: stone door closed, stone door open, star port by day, star port by night (warm light), star dot relief, arc relief, wind cord post, stone lamp niche unlit, stone lamp niche lit, stone steps, stone balustrade, dragon vertebra carving, string of silver bells, ice-blue stone bead, seven-dot mark over the door, stone disc on the gable.

items.notes: 16 格严格按补充说明的顺序；夜窗与点亮的灯用暖色自发光；招牌只画纹章图形，任何地方都不写字。

subject.zh: 七席石：七座高背石座中的三座排成半环的一段，灰白花岗岩凿成，椅背高过人头，石面风化出细坑，刻着古老的弧线纹，座前各有一级石阶
subject.en: The Seven Seats: three of the seven high-backed stone seats forming part of the half ring, cut from gray-white granite, backs taller than a person, weathered with fine pits and carved with ancient arcs, a stone step before each

extra.zh: 约 8 米宽、5 米高；只画半环正对镜头的一段；不画碑。
extra.en: About 8 m wide and 5 m tall; only the stretch of the half ring facing the viewer; no stele.

items.notes: 底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 观穹台：凿进西坡岩壁的石屋，深灰方石砌的门脸，上方一座铅皮小穹顶开着一道缝，缝里伸出黄铜望远镜，岩壁上凿着通往台顶的石阶
subject.en: The Vaultwatch: a stone house cut into the western cliff, a dark gray ashlar front, a small lead dome above with a slit through which a brass telescope protrudes, steps carved in the rock leading to the top

extra.zh: 约 7 米宽、9 米高；望远镜指向左上方。
extra.en: About 7 m wide and 9 m tall; the telescope points to the upper left.

items.notes: 底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 山间驿站：厚墙石砌的两层驿站，厚石板屋顶，门前立着挂风绳的木杆，侧面接着一排马厩，烟囱冒着细烟
subject.en: A mountain way station: a two-story thick-walled stone inn with heavy slab roofs, a pole hung with wind cords before the door, a row of stables joined at the side, a thin plume from the chimney

extra.zh: 约 8 米宽、8 米高；不画积雪。
extra.en: About 8 m wide and 8 m tall; no snow.

items.notes: 底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 峭壁栈道：钉在冰蓝岩壁上的一段木栈道，木板由斜撑的木桩托着，外侧拉着粗麻绳栏，栈道转过岩角消失
subject.en: A cliff plankway: a stretch of timber walkway pinned to an ice-blue rock face, planks supported by slanted struts, a thick hemp rope rail on the outer side, the walkway turning around a corner of rock and out of sight

extra.zh: 约 8 米宽、6 米高；岩壁只画栈道附近的一段。
extra.en: About 8 m wide and 6 m tall; only the rock near the walkway.

items.notes: 底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 封印遗迹的冷灰石墙：千年前切割的灰石块 #6e7270 错缝砌筑，砌缝细但多处开裂，石面有水渍、苔线 #5a6a4a 与崩落的缺角，四方无缝
subject.en: Cold gray stone wall of the sealed ruins: gray blocks #6e7270 cut a thousand years ago in a staggered bond, fine joints cracked in many places, water stains, moss lines #5a6a4a and chipped corners, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 本包最常用的墙材；室内地图的墙是半高剖面墙。四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 门形浮雕墙：冷灰石墙面上并排刻满大小相同的空门框浮雕，门框里是平的石面，浮雕边缘磨损，纹样均匀重复，四方无缝
subject.en: Door relief wall: a cold gray stone wall carved all over with rows of identical empty doorframe reliefs, flat stone inside each frame, worn edges, repeating evenly, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 浮雕是石刻，不发光，不用门扉金。四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 旧水道的砖拱墙：红褐旧砖 #6a5e52 顺砌，砖面湿滑长着暗绿水苔，砖缝渗着黑色水痕，四方无缝
subject.en: Brick wall of the old aqueduct: old red-brown bricks #6a5e52 in a running bond, slick with dark green water moss, black seep stains in the joints, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 霜骨墓窟的冰封骨墙：墙里一格格嵌着骨匣，表面结了一层青白冰壳 #9aa8c8，冰下隐约可见骨白与灰石，霜花沿缝生长，四方无缝
subject.en: Frozen ossuary wall of the Frostbone Catacombs: a wall of bone niches in a grid under a blue-white ice crust #9aa8c8, bone white and gray stone faintly visible beneath, frost flowers growing along the joints, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 殉光地下墓的白瓷骨匣墙：一格格惨白色的瓷骨匣整齐嵌满墙面，每格匣面刻一枚小光轮，瓷面有细密的冰裂纹，四方无缝
subject.en: Porcelain ossuary wall of the Martyrlight Catacombs: pallid porcelain bone caskets set neatly in a grid over the whole wall, each casket face incised with a small halo, fine crackle on the glaze, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 封印遗迹的墙基、压檐与檐边：千年前的冷灰石线脚，处处崩缺、长苔、积灰，刻纹磨得只剩浅痕，配色取冷灰与苔绿
subject.en: Base, cap and eave trims for the sealed ruins: cold gray stone moldings, broken and mossy, in cold gray and moss green

extra.zh: 第 1 行墙基：崩缺的冷灰石勒脚；第 2 行墙顶压檐：半高剖面墙参差的断石压顶；第 3 行屋檐封边：刻着门形小纹的石檐口残段；第 4 行山墙封檐板：断裂的石雕卷叶。
extra.en: Row 1 wall base: a chipped cold gray stone plinth; row 2 wall cap: the jagged broken top of a cutaway wall; row 3 eave fascia: a fragment of stone cornice carved with small door motifs; row 4 gable bargeboard: a broken carved leaf scroll.

items.notes: 4 条之间用洋红隔开；每条的左右两端要能首尾相接；每条上沿留一道亮边。

subject.zh: 封印遗迹的立面构件：门形石拱、空门框、壁龛、铁火盆壁架、锁链与铁栅，配色取冷灰、铁锈与暖橙火光
subject.en: Facade pieces for the sealed ruins: door-shaped stone arches, empty doorframes, niches, iron brazier brackets, chains and iron grilles, in cold gray, rust and warm orange firelight

extra.zh: 16 格依次为：门形石拱（完整）、门形石拱（半塌）、空门框（站立）、空门框（倒伏的一段）、壁龛（空）、壁龛（放着一盏油灯）、六神纹门楣残块（光轮、断剑、硬币）、六神纹门楣残块（枝叶、书卷、被凿空的门形）、铁栅门（关）、铁栅门（开）、墙上的锁链、石雕卷叶残块、铁火盆壁架（熄）、铁火盆壁架（燃）、渗水的墙洞、被凿掉的浮雕。
extra.en: The 16 cells in order: door-shaped stone arch (whole), door-shaped stone arch (half collapsed), empty doorframe standing, a fallen piece of doorframe, empty niche, niche with an oil lamp, lintel fragment with three sigils (halo, broken sword, coin), lintel fragment with three sigils (branch, scroll, a chiseled-out door shape), iron grille door closed, iron grille door open, chains on the wall, broken carved leaf scroll, iron brazier bracket unlit, iron brazier bracket burning, a seeping hole in the wall, a chiseled-away relief.

items.notes: 16 格严格按补充说明的顺序；夜窗与点亮的灯用暖色自发光；招牌只画纹章图形，任何地方都不写字。

subject.zh: 旧水道与帝国水道的立面构件：砖拱、水闸、铁栅、铜铭牌与排水口，铭牌只有图形，配色取红褐砖、锈铁、铜绿与冷灰
subject.en: Facade pieces for the old and imperial aqueducts: brick arches, sluices, iron grilles, bronze plaques and outfalls, the plaques carrying shapes only, in red-brown brick, rusty iron, verdigris and cold gray

extra.zh: 16 格依次为：砖拱通道口、方石拱通道口、水闸门（关）、水闸门（开）、铁栅（关）、铁栅（开）、排水口（干）、排水口（淌水）、铜铭牌（只有门形与圆圈图形）、铁梯、绞盘、一段锁链、墙灯（熄）、墙灯（亮）、拱顶石饰、简化的鹰首石雕。
extra.en: The 16 cells in order: brick arch tunnel mouth, ashlar arch tunnel mouth, sluice gate closed, sluice gate open, iron grille closed, iron grille open, outfall dry, outfall running, bronze plaque (only door and circle shapes), iron ladder, winch, a length of chain, wall lamp off, wall lamp lit, keystone ornament, simplified eagle-head carving.

items.notes: 铭牌上不能出现数字，第三十七门的编号由界面给。16 格严格按补充说明的顺序；夜窗与点亮的灯用暖色自发光；招牌只画纹章图形，任何地方都不写字。

subject.zh: 灰烬室北墙的巨门：一扇高大的古石门紧闭，门板刻着巨大的门形神纹，五道淡淡发光的锁链从四周交叉缠住门板，在门心汇成一个结，门前积着到膝的灰
subject.en: The great door in the north wall of the ash chamber: a towering ancient stone door shut tight, carved with a huge door-shaped sigil, five faintly glowing chains crossing over it from all sides and meeting in a knot at its center, knee-deep ash before it

extra.zh: 约 6 米宽、8 米高；五道锁链的微光各略有不同的冷色调；门缝里没有光。
extra.en: About 6 m wide and 8 m tall; each of the five chains glows in a slightly different cool tone; no light from the door crack.

items.notes: 这是第一幕的关键画面之一：门要显得沉重、古老、被牢牢锁住。底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 外庭倒塌的柱廊：三根冷灰石柱，一根完整撑着一截横梁，一根断成半截，一根倒在地上碎成几段，柱身刻着竖向凹槽，柱脚长着苔与灰草
subject.en: The fallen colonnade of the outer court: three cold gray columns, one whole and carrying a length of architrave, one broken in half, one toppled and shattered on the ground, fluted shafts, moss and gray grass at their feet

extra.zh: 约 8 米宽、7 米高；不画地面。
extra.en: About 8 m wide and 7 m tall; no ground.

items.notes: 底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 粗凿的矿道岩壁：暗褐岩面 #4a3e36 留着一道道斜向的镐痕，岩面凹凸，渗着水痕与铁锈色 #8a3a24 的矿斑，湿苔点点，四方无缝
subject.en: Rough-hewn mine tunnel wall: dark brown rock #4a3e36 scored with diagonal pick marks, uneven, seeping water stains and rust-colored #8a3a24 ore spots, specks of wet moss, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 本包最常用的墙材。四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 原木支护的矿道墙：粗凿岩壁前每隔约 1.5 米立一根原木支柱 #6a5a4e，柱间横钉着挡板，木料被煤灰熏黑，四方无缝
subject.en: Timbered mine wall: a log prop #6a5a4e standing about every 1.5 m in front of the rough rock, lagging boards nailed across between them, the wood blackened by coal dust, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 晶脉岩壁：暗岩 #4a3e36 被一道道淡紫色晶脉切开，晶脉闪着硬边高光，走向随机，岩缝里渗着冷光，四方无缝
subject.en: Crystal vein rock wall: dark rock #4a3e36 cut by pale violet crystal veins with hard-edged highlights running at random, cold light seeping from the cracks, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 矮人山城的条石墙：长条暗灰石 #5a6268 切割精准、严丝合缝，每隔几层嵌一道黄铜色 #c8a04a 金属条，石面刻着浅浅的矿纹线，四方无缝
subject.en: Dwarven ashlar of the mountain city: long dark gray stones #5a6268 cut precisely and fitted without gaps, a brass-colored #c8a04a metal band set every few courses, shallow ore-pattern lines carved in the faces, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 赤砧山（E5）用。四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 炉砖墙：耐火砖 #8a3a24 被炉火烧成深浅不一的红黑色，砖缝填着白色耐火泥，砖面有烧裂与熔渣流痕，四方无缝
subject.en: Furnace brick wall: firebricks #8a3a24 baked by the fires to mottled red and black, white fireclay in the joints, heat cracks and runs of slag on the faces, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 矮人的厚石板低坡屋面：厚重的暗灰石板 #5a6268 错缝平铺，石板边缘切得笔直，每块石板用铁扣固定，铁扣成行，四方无缝
subject.en: Dwarven heavy slab low-pitch roof: thick dark gray slabs #5a6268 in a staggered lap, edges cut dead straight, each slab held by iron clamps in neat rows, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 赤砧山地面以上的建筑用。瓦行或草层必须水平、屋脊方向在上；不画屋脊与檐口（由条带贴）；生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝。

subject.zh: 矿道与炉城的墙基、压檐与檐边：被煤灰熏黑的原木、铁件与矮人条石，配色取原木黄、煤黑、铁锈与黄铜
subject.en: Base, cap and eave trims for mines and the forge city: timber, ironwork and dressed stone in raw timber yellow, coal black, rust and brass

extra.zh: 第 1 行墙基：碎石垫着的原木地梁；第 2 行墙顶压檐：一根横撑的原木顶梁；第 3 行屋檐封边：钉着铁皮的木檐；第 4 行山墙封檐板：矮人式条石檐口，刻着矿纹线。
extra.en: Row 1 wall base: a log sill on rubble packing; row 2 wall cap: a horizontal log cap beam; row 3 eave fascia: a timber eave clad in sheet iron; row 4 gable bargeboard: a dwarven ashlar cornice carved with ore lines.

items.notes: 4 条之间用洋红隔开；每条的左右两端要能首尾相接；每条上沿留一道亮边。

subject.zh: 矿坑与炉城的立面构件：矿口木框、包铁门、炉口、齿轮机关门与矿灯，配色取原木黄、铁锈、黄铜与炉火橙
subject.en: Facade pieces for mines and the forge city: mine mouth frames, iron-bound doors, furnace mouths, geared mechanism doors and miner lamps, in raw timber yellow, rust, brass and furnace orange

extra.zh: 16 格依次为：矿口木框（空，里面黑）、矿口木框（钉着木板封住）、包铁木门（关）、包铁木门（开）、炉口（熄）、炉口（燃）、齿轮机关门（关）、齿轮机关门（开）、镐与锤纹章招牌、铁砧纹章招牌、铁皮雨棚、铁烟筒、矿灯（熄）、矿灯（亮）、刻着矿纹的矮人门楣、通风口铁栅。
extra.en: The 16 cells in order: mine mouth frame empty (dark inside), mine mouth frame boarded up, iron-bound door closed, iron-bound door open, furnace mouth cold, furnace mouth burning, geared mechanism door closed, geared mechanism door open, pick and hammer emblem sign, anvil emblem sign, sheet iron awning, iron stovepipe, miner lamp off, miner lamp lit, dwarven lintel carved with ore lines, iron vent grille.

items.notes: 16 格严格按补充说明的顺序；夜窗与点亮的灯用暖色自发光；招牌只画纹章图形，任何地方都不写字。

subject.zh: 锈岭矿的矿口：粗原木搭成的方形矿口木框，框顶横梁挂着一盏矿灯，矿口里是黑暗的斜坡矿道，一条木轨从矿口伸出，两侧岩坡带着锈红矿斑
subject.en: The mouth of Rustridge Mine: a square frame of rough logs, a miner lamp hanging from the top beam, a dark sloping tunnel inside, a wooden rail line running out of it, rust red ore stains on the rock to either side

extra.zh: 约 6 米宽、6 米高；矿口里只画黑，不画深处。
extra.en: About 6 m wide and 6 m tall; the tunnel is plain black inside.

items.notes: A2 与 A5 共用。底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 赤砧山的炉塔：矮人条石砌的粗壮圆塔，塔身箍着几道黄铜带，塔顶敞开的炉口喷着橙红火光与黑烟，塔脚是厚重的拱门与铁门
subject.en: A forge tower of Mount Redanvil: a stout round tower of dwarven ashlar bound with brass bands, its open top belching orange-red fire and black smoke, a heavy arched iron door at its foot

extra.zh: 约 6 米宽、12 米高；火光用硬边的橙黄色块，黑烟只画两三团。
extra.en: About 6 m wide and 12 m tall; fire as hard-edged orange-yellow shapes, only two or three puffs of black smoke.

items.notes: 底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 门框叠成的墙：大大小小的旧门框 #5a5a68 紧挨着竖排叠在一起，框里是幽暗的平面，个别门缝透出一线暖白偏金的光 #f0d890，四方无缝
subject.en: A wall of stacked doorframes: old frames #5a5a68 of every size packed side by side and on top of each other, dark flat panels inside them, a thin line of warm white-gold light #f0d890 at a few cracks, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 门扉金只在少数门缝里，一像素宽。四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 锁与钥匙纹样的墙板：暗灰紫 #4a4458 墙板上浮雕着成排的锁孔与钥匙图形，图形边缘是褪色的旧铜 #8a7448，纹样均匀重复，四方无缝
subject.en: Lock and key paneling: dark gray-violet #4a4458 panels with rows of keyhole and key shapes in relief, edged in faded old copper #8a7448, repeating evenly, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 镜面般的暗墙：近乎黑的深蓝灰平面 #16161e，像一面暗镜，零散地映出模糊的门框轮廓，只用两三级暗色，四方无缝
subject.en: A mirror-dark wall: a near-black deep blue-gray plane #16161e like a dark mirror, scattered blurred reflections of doorframes in two or three dark steps, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 梦中门口的旧灰泥墙：褪色的米灰灰泥 #b8b8c0 有细裂与水渍，墙面泛着低饱和的蓝灰，像一段记不清的旧屋墙，四方无缝
subject.en: Old plaster wall of the dream doorway: faded beige-gray plaster #b8b8c0 with fine cracks and water marks, a desaturated blue-gray cast like the wall of a half-remembered house, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 门廊幽境的墙基、压檐与檐边：门槛石、门楣木、铰链与锁扣，配色取暗灰、旧铜与门扉金微光
subject.en: Base, cap and eave trims for the Door Corridor: threshold stones, lintel timbers, hinges and hasps in dark gray, old copper and a faint door gold glow

extra.zh: 第 1 行墙基：一排门槛石；第 2 行墙顶压檐：一排连在一起的门楣木；第 3 行屋檐封边：钉满旧铰链的木檐；第 4 行山墙封檐板：挂着一排小锁的铁条。
extra.en: Row 1 wall base: a row of threshold stones; row 2 wall cap: a run of joined lintel timbers; row 3 eave fascia: a timber eave studded with old hinges; row 4 gable bargeboard: an iron bar hung with a row of small padlocks.

items.notes: 4 条之间用洋红隔开；每条的左右两端要能首尾相接；每条上沿留一道亮边。

subject.zh: 门廊幽境的悬浮门：十六扇不同年代、不同材质的门，有的紧闭，有的微开，微开的门缝透出暖白偏金的光，配色取暗灰、木褐、铁灰、旧铜与门扉金
subject.en: Floating doors of the Door Corridor: sixteen doors of different eras and materials, some shut, some ajar with warm white-gold light at the gap, in dark gray, wood brown, iron gray, old copper and door gold

extra.zh: 16 格依次为：木门（关）、木门（微开，门缝透光）、石门（关）、石门（微开）、铁门（关）、铁门（微开）、雕花双扇门（关）、雕花双扇门（微开）、矮小的圆门（关）、高窄的门（关）、挂着门帘的门洞、只剩门框的门、钉满铆钉的门、贴着空白纸条的门、带猫眼的旧公寓门（没有门牌号）、玻璃门（关，后面是暗）。
extra.en: The 16 cells in order: wooden door shut, wooden door ajar (light at the gap), stone door shut, stone door ajar, iron door shut, iron door ajar, carved double door shut, carved double door ajar, small round door shut, tall narrow door shut, doorway hung with a curtain, a bare doorframe, a door studded with rivets, a door with blank paper strips pasted on it, an old apartment door with a peephole and no number, a glass door shut with darkness behind.

items.notes: 每扇门都悬空，底边仍贴格底。16 格严格按补充说明的顺序；夜窗与点亮的灯用暖色自发光；招牌只画纹章图形，任何地方都不写字。

subject.zh: 门与锁的小构件：锁孔片、门环、门把手、铰链、门闩、挂锁与门灯，样式古旧精致，配色取旧铜、铁灰与暖光
subject.en: Small door and lock pieces: keyhole plates, knockers, handles, hinges, bolts and door lamps, in old copper, iron gray and warm light

extra.zh: 16 格依次为：圆锁孔片、方锁孔片、狮首门环、圆环门环、圆门把手、拉杆门把手、一对铰链、门闩（插上）、门闩（拉开）、挂锁（锁着）、挂锁（打开）、一段锁链、门灯（熄）、门灯（亮）、空白的门牌位、门上的猫眼。
extra.en: The 16 cells in order: round keyhole plate, square keyhole plate, lion-head knocker, ring knocker, round knob, lever handle, a pair of hinges, bolt shot, bolt drawn, padlock locked, padlock open, a length of chain, door lamp off, door lamp lit, blank house plate, door peephole.

items.notes: 16 格严格按补充说明的顺序；夜窗与点亮的灯用暖色自发光；招牌只画纹章图形，任何地方都不写字。

subject.zh: 梦中门口的立面构件：一座旧屋门前的门廊、门楣、风铃与门前台阶，低饱和的蓝灰与暖光，像记不清的旧梦
subject.en: Facade pieces for the dream doorway: the porch, lintel, wind chime and front steps of an old house, desaturated blue-gray with warm light, like a half-remembered dream

extra.zh: 16 格依次为：旧木门（关）、旧木门（开一条缝，门缝透暖光）、门旁小窗（昼，蓝灰）、门旁小窗（夜，暖光）、门廊柱、门廊栏杆、风铃、门前台阶、门廊雨棚、空白的旧信箱、门垫、枯了的花盆、门灯（熄）、门灯（亮）、木门楣、空白的旧门牌。
extra.en: The 16 cells in order: old wooden door shut, old wooden door open a crack (warm light at the gap), small side window by day (blue-gray), small side window by night (warm light), porch post, porch railing, wind chime, front steps, porch canopy, blank old mailbox, doormat, a withered potted plant, door lamp off, door lamp lit, wooden lintel, blank old house plate.

items.notes: 不画任何人物。16 格严格按补充说明的顺序；夜窗与点亮的灯用暖色自发光；招牌只画纹章图形，任何地方都不写字。

subject.zh: 门廊幽境的巨门：一扇高大的拱形双扇门悬在黑暗里，门板是暗色旧木包着铜边，门上刻满钥匙与锁的纹样，两扇门之间留着一线暖白偏金的光，门前悬着三级门槛石
subject.en: The great door of the Door Corridor: a towering arched double door hanging in the dark, panels of dark old wood edged in copper, carved all over with keys and locks, a thin line of warm white-gold light between the leaves, three floating threshold stones before it

extra.zh: 约 6 米宽、11 米高；门缝的光是唯一的亮色。
extra.en: About 6 m wide and 11 m tall; the light at the gap is the only bright color.

items.notes: 底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 门叠成的阶梯：一扇扇平放的旧门叠成一道向上的阶梯，每扇门的颜色与材质都不同，阶梯两侧悬着几扇竖着的门框，阶梯顶端是一扇微开的小门
subject.en: A stair of doors: old doors laid flat and stacked into a rising stair, each a different color and material, a few upright doorframes floating beside it, a small door ajar at the top

extra.zh: 约 7 米宽、10 米高；阶梯从左下升向右上。
extra.en: About 7 m wide and 10 m tall; the stair rises from lower left to upper right.

items.notes: 底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 末班电车车厢的内墙板：浅灰米色 #d8d0b0 的金属内饰板，带细细的横向压纹与圆头螺钉，板缝整齐，没有任何文字、标识与广告，四方无缝
subject.en: Interior wall panels of the last train: pale gray-beige #d8d0b0 metal trim panels with fine horizontal ribbing and round-head screws, neat seams, no lettering, signs or ads, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 便利店的白瓷砖墙：方形白瓷砖 #e8eaec 对缝铺满，砖缝浅灰，色调是荧光灯下的冷白，四方无缝
subject.en: White tiled wall of the convenience store: square white ceramic tiles #e8eaec joint to joint, pale gray grout, the cold white of fluorescent light, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 医院走廊的墙：墙面刷成浅灰绿 #b8bcc4，腰部一道浅灰色防撞护墙条，护墙条画成一道横条，全图均匀重复，四方无缝
subject.en: Hospital corridor wall: painted pale gray-green #b8bcc4 with a pale gray bump rail at waist height drawn as one horizontal band repeating evenly, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 老宅褪色的墙纸：米黄底 #d8d0b0 上印着细小的褐色碎花，纹样连续重复，墙纸起翘泛黄，零散有两三处挂过相框留下的浅色方印，四方无缝
subject.en: Faded wallpaper of the old house: small brown sprigs on a beige ground #d8d0b0 repeating continuously, the paper curling and yellowed, two or three pale squares scattered where frames once hung, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 浅色方印零散分布，不要排成整齐的一列。四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 当代室内的墙基、压檐与檐边：铝条、踢脚板、扶手与吊顶边，配色取冷灰、米白与木褐，干净实用，没有文字
subject.en: Base, cap and edge trims for modern interiors: aluminum strips, skirting, handrails and ceiling edges in cool gray, off-white and wood brown, plain and practical, no lettering

extra.zh: 第 1 行墙基：车厢的铝制踢脚条；第 2 行墙顶压檐：便利店的白色吊顶边条；第 3 行屋檐封边：医院走廊的浅灰防撞扶手；第 4 行山墙封檐板：老宅的深褐木踢脚板。
extra.en: Row 1 wall base: the aluminum kick strip of the train car; row 2 wall cap: the white ceiling edge strip of the store; row 3 eave fascia: the pale gray handrail of the hospital corridor; row 4 gable bargeboard: the dark brown wooden skirting of the old house.

items.notes: 4 条之间用洋红隔开；每条的左右两端要能首尾相接；每条上沿留一道亮边。

subject.zh: 末班电车车厢的立面构件：车窗、车门、吊环与行李架，车窗外是夜色，没有任何文字、线路图与广告，配色取冷灰、米白与窗外的夜蓝
subject.en: Facade pieces for the last train car: windows, doors, hand straps and luggage racks, night outside the windows, no lettering, route maps or ads, in cool gray, off-white and night blue

extra.zh: 16 格依次为：车窗（夜，窗外暗蓝与零星灯光）、车窗（夜，映着车内灯光）、车门（关）、车门（开）、车门上的玻璃窗、车厢连接处的小门、一排吊环、行李架、空白的广告框、车厢灯（熄）、车厢灯（亮）、无字的紧急按钮、一段座椅靠背、扶手杆、通风格栅、挂着雨滴的车窗。
extra.en: The 16 cells in order: window at night (dark blue with scattered lights outside), window at night (reflecting the car lights), door closed, door open, door window, small gangway door, a row of hand straps, luggage rack, blank ad frame, car light off, car light lit, emergency button with no lettering, a stretch of seat back, grab pole, ventilation grille, window beaded with rain.

items.notes: 16 格严格按补充说明的顺序；夜窗与点亮的灯用暖色自发光；招牌只画纹章图形，任何地方都不写字。

subject.zh: 便利店的立面构件：玻璃门、冷柜门、收银台正面与货架端头，所有包装与招牌都是无字的色块，配色取冷白、浅蓝与暖黄
subject.en: Facade pieces for the convenience store: glass doors, fridge doors, the counter front and shelf ends, all packaging and signs as wordless color blocks, in cold white, pale blue and warm yellow

extra.zh: 16 格依次为：玻璃自动门（关）、玻璃自动门（开）、橱窗（夜，店内冷白光）、冷柜玻璃门（满货色块）、冷柜玻璃门（半空）、收银台正面、货架端头（色块包装）、杂志架（封面是空白色块）、一段雨棚、饮料售卖机正面（按钮无字）、伞架、无字的垃圾桶、招牌灯箱（熄）、招牌灯箱（亮，无字）、门口地垫、门铃。
extra.en: The 16 cells in order: automatic glass door closed, automatic glass door open, shop window at night (cold white light inside), fridge glass door full (color blocks), fridge glass door half empty, counter front, shelf end (color-block packages), magazine rack (blank color-block covers), a stretch of awning, drink vending machine front (unlabeled buttons), umbrella stand, trash bin with no lettering, sign lightbox off, sign lightbox lit (no lettering), doormat, door chime.

items.notes: 包装、屏幕、招牌只用色块，出现任何字形就淘汰。16 格严格按补充说明的顺序；夜窗与点亮的灯用暖色自发光；招牌只画纹章图形，任何地方都不写字。

subject.zh: 医院走廊与老宅的立面构件：病房门、长椅、窗与老宅的木门、挂钟，配色取浅灰绿、米白、木褐与冷暖两种灯光，安静疲惫
subject.en: Facade pieces for the hospital corridor and the old house: ward doors, benches, windows, the old house doors and a wall clock, in pale gray-green, off-white, wood brown and both cold and warm light, quiet and weary

extra.zh: 16 格依次为：病房门（关）、病房门（开，里面暗）、走廊窗（夜，外面下雨）、走廊窗（昼）、等候长椅、点滴架、空白告示板、走廊灯（熄）、走廊灯（亮）、老宅木门（关）、老宅木门（开）、老宅窗（昼，旧纱帘）、老宅窗（夜，暖光）、墙上的旧挂钟（没有数字）、贴着胶带的纸箱一角、门框上的身高刻痕（只是短横线）。
extra.en: The 16 cells in order: ward door closed, ward door open (dark inside), corridor window at night (rain outside), corridor window by day, waiting bench, IV stand, blank notice board, corridor light off, corridor light lit, old house door closed, old house door open, old house window by day (old sheer curtain), old house window by night (warm light), old wall clock (no numerals), corner of a taped cardboard box, height marks on a doorframe (short lines only).

items.notes: 16 格严格按补充说明的顺序；夜窗与点亮的灯用暖色自发光；招牌只画纹章图形，任何地方都不写字。

subject.zh: 雨夜的通宵便利店门面：白瓷砖外墙、整面玻璃橱窗透出冷白的光，门口一块无字的招牌灯箱亮着，雨棚下立着一台饮料售卖机与一只伞架，玻璃上挂着雨滴
subject.en: An all-night convenience store front on a rainy night: white tiled walls, a full glass shopfront glowing cold white, a lit wordless sign lightbox over the door, a drink vending machine and an umbrella stand under the awning, rain beading on the glass

extra.zh: 约 8 米宽、5 米高；所有招牌、包装与屏幕都是无字的色块。
extra.en: About 8 m wide and 5 m tall; every sign, package and screen is a wordless color block.

items.notes: 底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 末班电车的一节车厢侧面：银灰色车身带一道蓝色腰线，一排车窗透出暖白的车内灯光，车门紧闭，车顶有受电弓，车身上没有任何文字与编号
subject.en: The side of one car of the last train: a silver-gray body with a blue waist stripe, a row of windows glowing warm white from the lights inside, doors shut, a pantograph on the roof, no lettering or numbers anywhere on the body

extra.zh: 约 8 米宽、4 米高；只画车厢的一段，左右截出画面。
extra.en: About 8 m wide and 4 m tall; only a section of the car, cut off at both sides.

items.notes: 底边贴住画面底边并水平居中；不画地面与投影；所有招牌、旗帜、碑面都不写字。

subject.zh: 施工中的地基构件：木桩、拉线、粗凿石基与新木地梁，木料是新砍的浅黄木 #9a7448，石料是灰毛石，沾着泥土与木屑，所有风格包通用
subject.en: Foundation pieces for buildings under construction: stakes, string lines, rough-cut stone footings and new timber sills, freshly cut pale timber #9a7448 and gray fieldstone with mud and sawdust on them, shared by every style pack

extra.zh: 第 1 行：一排打进地里的木桩与拉线；第 2 行：粗凿的灰石基，石缝还没勾缝；第 3 行：带斧痕的新木地梁；第 4 行：钉子露头的粗木板封边。
extra.en: Row 1: a line of stakes driven into the ground with string; row 2: rough gray stone footings with unpointed joints; row 3: new timber sills with axe marks; row 4: a rough board edge with nail heads showing.

items.notes: 建造阶段 1 地基用；4 条之间用洋红隔开，每条左右两端能首尾相接。4 条之间用洋红隔开；每条的左右两端要能首尾相接；每条上沿留一道亮边。

subject.en: Wall in the framing stage: a timber frame of freshly cut pale posts and braces #9a7448, about half the bays filled with wattle and daub and the rest still open showing dark behind, axe marks and nails in the wood, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 建造阶段 2 框架用：墙高按进度截取；空格画成暗色，不画透明。四方无缝：生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝与重复中心；不画门窗、墙基与墙顶（由条带与立面构件贴）；光从左上方，不画环境阴影。

subject.zh: 施工中的立面构件：脚手架、梯子、木板、吊绳与工具，木料是新砍的浅黄木，绳是麻黄色，所有风格包通用
subject.en: Construction facade pieces: scaffolding, ladders, planks, hoist ropes and tools in freshly cut pale timber and hemp yellow rope, shared by every style pack

extra.zh: 16 格依次为：一节竖杆、一节横杆、交叉斜撑、一块脚手板、短木梯、长木梯、吊绳与滑轮、灰浆桶、一捆木板、一堆砖、搭在墙上的油布、竖着的锯、挂着的工具袋、提灯（熄）、提灯（亮）、绑着彩布的封顶小树枝。
extra.en: The 16 cells in order: an upright pole section, a horizontal ledger section, crossed braces, a scaffold board, a short ladder, a long ladder, hoist rope with pulley, mortar bucket, a bundle of planks, a stack of bricks, a tarp draped over a wall, a saw standing upright, a hanging tool bag, lantern off, lantern lit, a topping-out sprig tied with colored cloth.

subject.zh: 封顶阶段的屋面：新木椽子 #9a7448 竖向排列，上面横钉着细挂瓦条，条与条之间露出下方的暗色，木料带斧痕，椽子竖直、挂瓦条水平，四方无缝
subject.en: Roof in the topping-out stage: new timber rafters #9a7448 running up the slope with thin battens nailed across them, dark showing between the battens, axe marks on the wood, rafters vertical and battens horizontal, seamless on all sides

items.notes: 建造阶段 3 封顶用：渲染层按抖动由下向上把它换成正式屋面。瓦行或草层必须水平、屋脊方向在上；不画屋脊与檐口（由条带贴）；生成后 2×2 拼起来检查接缝。

subject.en: The headframe of a domain mine: a square tapering frame of four thick logs, a big wooden sheave at the top carrying rope, a wooden windlass beside it, a black pit mouth below with cart rails running in

extra.zh: 约 5 米宽、8 米高。
extra.en: About 5 m wide and 8 m tall.

subject.en: A charcoal kiln: a domed earth kiln plastered with black-brown mud, a few smoke holes with white smoke rising, the mouth half sealed with stones, neatly stacked split logs beside it

extra.zh: 约 5 米宽、4 米高；白烟只画硬边的两三团。

subject.en: A smelter: a square tapering brick furnace with an orange-red glow at its mouth, an ox-hide bellows with a wooden treadle hung on its side, ore and charcoal heaped at its foot

subject.en: A wooden watchtower: four log posts holding a lookout hut about 6 m up, plank walls and a sloping roof, a beacon basket hung at the eave, a wooden ladder straight up to the hut

extra.zh: 约 4 米宽、9 米高；修复后的旧哨村哨塔也用这一张。

subject.en: A stone arrow tower: a round gray stone tower with tall narrow arrow slits, crenellations around the top and a domain banner behind them

subject.en: A gatehouse: two square stone towers flanking an arched gate with an iron portcullis raised above it, crenellated tops, a banner over the archway

subject.en: The domain chapel: the front of a tall-walled stone chapel with a round window, a square bell tower rising at one side with a bell in its opening, three steps at the door, a round stone disc over the door as the place for a sigil

extra.zh: 约 7 米宽、10 米高；圆形石盘是空的，圣徽另贴。
extra.en: About 7 m wide and 10 m tall; the disc is blank, the sigil is applied separately.

subject.en: The settlement side of a portal: a stone doorframe of three dressed stones standing alone with no wall, the lintel stone warm gold, the air inside the frame faintly shining, one step before it

extra.zh: 约 3 米宽、3 米高；框内只画极淡的光，不画对面的景象。
extra.en: About 3 m wide and 3 m tall; only the faintest light inside the frame, no view of the far side.

subject.en: A nameless shrine: a small doorframe with no door standing on a square stone base, a door lamp and a few knotted cord charms set beneath it, a bunch of wildflowers at the edge

extra.zh: 约 2 米宽、2.5 米高；门框是普通灰石，不发光。

subject.en: The great tent of the legion camp: a big square canvas tent held up by many poles, its roof ends turned up, a company banner hung on the front, a row of flagpoles and a weapon rack before it

subject.en: A diansteel furnace: a black brick body bound with three iron hoops, a violet-tinged white fire at its mouth, a water trough at the side giving off steam, a thick chimney on top

subject.en: An elven clan treehouse: a ring platform house built around an ordinary large tree, much smaller than the giant treehouses of the canopy, a leaf-tile roof, a vine bridge to one side and glowfly lamps under the eaves

subject.en: A dwarf clan rock hall: a stone-fronted dwelling half sunk into a rocky slope, a heavy stone lintel carved with ore lines, an iron ring by the door, a forge vent rising from the slope above

subject.en: A counting house: the front of a stone-pillared office, two columns carrying a flat roof, a pair of scales carved over the door, a counter and brass scales visible under the porch

subject.en: A crystal cannon tower: a squat round stone gun platform, a black iron barrel reaching out over the parapet, the crystal chamber behind the barrel glowing red

subject.en: The founding stele and boundary altar: a low altar built of homeland stones in five colors, a blank stele standing before it, a ring of stone benches around it, no idol

subject.zh: 众门环节点（主门坑）：灰石环台围着一道高约 4 米的门框，门框发着暖金光，环台边是执钥人的灰帐篷与一圈低矮的夯土石墙，门纹只刻在石墙内侧
subject.en: Gate ring node at the main crater: a gray stone ring platform around a doorframe about 4 m tall glowing warm gold, the keybearers gray tents and a low ring of rammed earth and old stone beside it, door marks carved only on the inner face of the wall

extra.zh: 约 7 米宽、6 米高；门框的暖金光只在门框里，其他地方不用门扉金。
extra.en: About 7 m wide and 6 m tall; the warm gold glow stays inside the doorframe, door gold is used nowhere else.

subject.en: Gate ring node beneath the World Tree: a ring platform covered in silver moss, the doorframe formed by two living roots arching together and glowing warm gold, silver lamps and vine curtains hung at the edge
